Mctt.Core.Soundness.Inductives.AtType

The Group's Gluing of an Element Is its Type's

An element of a member k of a group, glued in the group (ind_glu_elem), is glued at its type: the group's own clause of d_ind at a declared member, the container's at a view. This is the converse of Inductives/Bridge.v. By induction on the group's gluing: a constructor's arguments are glued at the closed telescope of its arguments, the non-recursive ones by the clause's families, the recursive ones by the induction, and the constructor applied to them is glued at its type (con_base, con_view_base); a neutral is (realize_glu_elem_bot). The eliminator glues the arguments of a constructor this way at the types of its branch's context.

Section Fixed_GCtx.
  Context {GC : GCtx}.

The gluing of a constructor of a member that is not a record view reads its stored parameters only after the uniform ones (ind_glu_elem_con): it holds at any other stored uniform parameters.
Lemma ind_glu_elem_con_prefix : forall p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Mk Γ Us Ns M hd k' c pre pre' rest,
    ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_is_rview Mk = false ->
    List.length pre = im_unu D Mk -> List.length pre' = List.length pre ->
    ind_glu_elem p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Γ Us Ns M (d_con hd k' c (pre ++ rest)) ->
    ind_glu_elem p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Γ Us Ns M (d_con hd k' c (pre' ++ rest)).
Proof.
  intros * HMk Hrv Hl Hl' H.
  inversion H; subst.
  all: match goal with H1 : ind_member _ _ = Some ?M1, H2 : ind_member _ _ = Some ?M2 |- _ =>
         assert_fails constr_eq M1 M2; rewrite H1 in H2; injection H2 as <- end.
  2: (unfold im_is_rview in Hrv; match goal with Hh : im_head _ = mh_record _ _ _ |- _ => rewrite Hh in Hrv end; discriminate).
  match goal with Ev : ?b0 ++ ?v0 = pre ++ rest, Hb0 : List.length ?b0 = _ |- _ =>
    rename Ev into Ev0; rename Hb0 into Hb00; rename b0 into bs0; rename v0 into vs0 end.
The stored parameters, split at the uniform ones
  assert (Ef : List.firstn (im_unu D Mk) bs0 = pre).
  { apply (f_equal (List.firstn (im_unu D Mk))) in Ev0.
    rewrite List.firstn_app, (proj2 (Nat.sub_0_le _ _)) in Ev0 by lia; cbn [List.firstn] in Ev0; rewrite List.app_nil_r in Ev0.
    rewrite <- Hl, firstn_app_exact in Ev0 by reflexivity; rewrite <- Hl; exact Ev0. }
  assert (Er : rest = List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs0 ++ vs0).
  { apply (f_equal (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk))) in Ev0.
    rewrite List.skipn_app, (proj2 (Nat.sub_0_le _ _)) in Ev0 by lia; cbn [List.skipn] in Ev0.
    rewrite <- Hl, skipn_app_exact in Ev0 by reflexivity; rewrite <- Hl; symmetry; exact Ev0. }
  rewrite Er, List.app_assoc.
  eapply ind_glu_elem_con; try eassumption;
    rewrite ?skipn_app_exact by lia; try eassumption.
  rewrite List.length_app, List.length_skipn; lia.
Qed.

So is the gluing at an inductive type of a constructor of its member (ind_glu_exp_pred): it holds at any other stored uniform parameters at which the value is in the type's relation. This is not a move of the gluing along a relation: the gluing's own clauses do not read the stored uniform parameters (ind_glu_elem_con reads List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs only, ind_glu_elem_con_prefix), and the rest of ind_glu_exp is about the term and its type.
Lemma glu_ind_con_prefix : forall (i : universe_index) hd k' xs P El Γ A M c pre pre' rest,
    DG d_ind hd k' xs ∈ glu_univ_elem i ↘ P ↘ El ->
    (forall D0, ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack hd = Some D0 -> List.length pre = ind_nu D0) -> List.length pre' = List.length pre ->
    (forall R, DF d_ind hd k' xs ≈ d_ind hd k' xs ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R -> R (d_con hd k' c (pre' ++ rest)) (d_con hd k' c (pre' ++ rest))) ->
    Γ ⊢ M : A ® d_con hd k' c (pre ++ rest) ∈ El ->
    Γ ⊢ M : A ® d_con hd k' c (pre' ++ rest) ∈ El.
Proof.
  intros * Hglu Hl Hl' Hrel HM.
  pose proof Hglu as Hglu'; invert_glu_univ_elem Hglu'.
  match goal with
    H : ind_lookup _ _ hd = Some ?D0, H1 : ind_member ?D0 k' = Some ?M0, H2 : im_head ?M0 = mh_decl ?pm,
    H4 : per_univ_elem _ ?er (d_ind hd k' _) _,
    H12 : _ <∙> ind_glu_exp_pred _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
      rename H into HlD0, H1 into HM0, H2 into Hh0, H4 into HR0, H12 into HEl0
  end.
  apply HEl0 in HM; destruct HM as [Hty Hper Ps HPs Hk].
  apply HEl0; refine (mk_ind_glu_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hty _ Ps HPs _).
  { exact (Hrel _ HR0). }
  intros Δ φ Ps' Hφ HPs'.
  eapply ind_glu_elem_con_prefix; [ exact HM0 | unfold im_is_rview; rewrite Hh0; reflexivity
                                  | unfold im_unu; rewrite Hh0; exact (Hl _ HlD0) | exact Hl' | exact (Hk _ _ _ Hφ HPs') ].
Qed.

    (Hviewsall : forall qn G, VP qn G -> glu_views_ok qn G).
The ends of the recursive arguments' shapes of the groups of VP are glued
  Hypothesis (HSall : forall qn G, VP qn G -> glu_self_ends_all qn G).
The records of their record views are glued (glu_rview_records)

The contexts of the arguments of the constructors of the groups of VP are glued (glu_group_cargs).

                 ind_con Mj c0 = Some gs0 -> ⊩ cargs_ctx q0 G0 Mj gs0 ++ im_params G0 Mj :=

  Let Hselfs := HSall _ _ HPD.
The ends at ups
  Let Hself := Hselfs ups bu u NP NEl AP AEl DP DEl Hu Hgu Hbu Hule Hf.

  #[local] Abbreviation nr := (canon_nparams_rel D ups).
  #[local] Abbreviation ar := (canon_args_rel D ups).

The Statements

An element M' of the member k at the uniform parameters Us' and the non-uniform ones Ns', glued in the group: at any gluing of its type's value at which its type is glued, it is glued.
  Definition elem_glu_at_type (k : nat) (Δ' : ctx) (Us' Ns' : list exp) (M' : exp) (mv : domain) : Prop :=
    forall Mk ns hd k' pre (i : nat) P El, ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
      ⟦mref k of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k', pre) ->
      glu_args Δ' (ind_uparams D) Id nil Us' ups -> Δ' ⊢ M' : im_ty_at p k Mk Us' Ns' ->
      glu_nparams k Mk NEl Δ' Us' Ns' ns -> tele_rel (nr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ns ns ->
      G k ups ups ns ns mv mv ->
      DG d_ind hd k' (pre ++ ns) ∈ glu_univ_elem i ↘ P ↘ El -> Δ' ⊢ im_ty_at p k Mk Us' Ns' ® P ->
      Δ' ⊢ M' : im_ty_at p k Mk Us' Ns' ® mv ∈ El.

An element M' of the record view k, glued in the group: at any gluing of the record type at the view's instance, at which its type is glued, it is glued.
  Definition rview_glu_at_type (k : nat) (Δ' : ctx) (Us' Ns' : list exp) (M' : exp) (mv : domain) : Prop :=
    forall Mk qr Is fl cups (i : nat) P El, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl ->
      ⟦ Is ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env D ups ↘ cups ->
      glu_args Δ' (ind_uparams D) Id nil Us' ups -> Δ' ⊢ M' : im_ty_at p k Mk Us' Ns' ->
      G k ups ups nil nil mv mv ->
      DG d_record qr cups ∈ glu_univ_elem i ↘ P ↘ El -> Δ' ⊢ im_ty_at p k Mk Us' Ns' ® P ->
      Δ' ⊢ M' : im_ty_at p k Mk Us' Ns' ® mv ∈ El.

A recursive argument N of shape t of a constructor c0 of the member k, after d domains of the shape, the components pre of its telescope Ts before, glued in the group, of a type glued along its shape (glu_shape_typ): at any gluing of the value of its shape's type at which its type is glued, it is glued.
  Definition rec_glu_at_type (k : nat) (Δ' : ctx) (Us' : list exp) (pre : list domain) (Ts : list centry) (t : ptyp)
      (A : typ) (N : exp) (v : domain) : Prop :=
    forall Mk ms c0 gs1 t0 gs2 ws d ys σs a (i : nat) P El,
      ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c0 = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) -> pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys ->
      Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn d (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
      tele_rel (nr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms ->
      tele_prefix_rel (ar k ms c0) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws ->
      ptyp_skip d t0 = t ->
      tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (dr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) d ys ys ->
      glu_args Δ' (ind_uparams D) Id nil Us' ups -> A = ptyp_ty_at p D Us' σs t ->
      glu_shape_typ (dr k) (DP k) (DEl k) (glu_self_params p D ups NEl) Δ' Us' pre Ts t A -> Δ' ⊢ N : A ->
      ⟦shty t of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups Ts pre ↘ a ->
      (forall R, DF a ≈ a ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R -> R v v) ->
      DG a ∈ glu_univ_elem i ↘ P ↘ El -> Δ' ⊢ A ® P -> Δ' ⊢ N : A ® v ∈ El.

The Relation of a Member's Type

mref reads no record view: its type is a record type.
  Lemma mref_not_rview : forall k Mk qr Is fl r, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl ->
      ⟦mref k of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ r -> False.
  Proof.
    intros * HMk Hh Hr; inversion Hr; subst;
      match goal with H : ind_lookup _ _ _ = Some ?D' |- _ => rewrite Hl in H; injection H as <- end; congruence.
  Qed.

So a member mref reads is not a record view.
  Lemma mref_rview_false : forall k Mk r, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ⟦mref k of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ r ->
      im_is_rview Mk = false.
  Proof.
    intros * HMk Hr; unfold im_is_rview; destruct (im_head Mk) eqn:Hh; [ reflexivity | reflexivity |].
    exfalso; exact (mref_not_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hr).
  Qed.

The relation of the value of a member's type, as mref reads its head and uniform parameters, is the group's at the member.
  Lemma mref_rel : forall k Mk hd k' pre ns (i : universe_index) R, ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
      ⟦mref k of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k', pre) ->
      DF d_ind hd k' (pre ++ ns) ≈ d_ind hd k' (pre ++ ns) ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R ->
      (R <~> G k ups ups ns ns).
  Proof.
    intros * HMk Hr HR.
    destruct (im_head Mk) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; [| | exfalso; exact (mref_not_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hr) ].
    - pose proof (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMk Hh Hr) as E; injection E as -> -> ->.
      exact (proj1 (valid_group_type_rel_base p D Hvg k Mk pm ups ups ups ups ns ns i R HMk Hh Hgu Hu Hgu Hgu HR)).
    - destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMk Hh Hr) as (py & E & Epy); injection E as -> -> <-.
      destruct (decl_typed_view _ _ _ Hdt _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh) as (Dq & Mk' & Hq & _).
      destruct (valid_group_views_view_args_values p D Hvg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hq ups ups Hgu Hu) as (c0 & c0' & E0 & E0' & Hc0).
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ E0 Epy) as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ E0' Epy) as ->.
      exact (Completeness.Inductives.ViewArgs.view_end_rel_all VP p D HVP HPD ups ups Hgu Hu k Mk qc kc Is vm Dq pre pre HMk Hh Hq Epy Epy pre pre ns ns i R Hc0 Hc0 HR).
  Qed.

The relation of a record view's type, the record at the view's instance, is the group's at the record view (rview_end_rel_all).
  Lemma rview_rel : forall j Mj qr Is fl cups (i : universe_index) R, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_head Mj = mh_record qr Is fl ->
      ⟦ Is ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env D ups ↘ cups ->
      DF d_record qr cups ≈ d_record qr cups ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R -> (R <~> G j ups ups nil nil).
  Proof.
    intros * HMj Hh Ecups HR.
    destruct (valid_group_records _ _ Hvg _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh) as [R0 HR0].
    pose proof (RviewEnds.rview_args_container_uparams_rel p D Hvg j Mj qr Is fl R0 HMj Hh HR0 ups cups Hgu Hu Ecups) as Hc0.
    exact (Completeness.Inductives.ViewArgs.rview_end_rel_all VP p D HVP HPD ups ups Hgu Hu j Mj qr Is fl R0 cups cups HMj Hh
             (valid_rview_record_lookup _ _ HR0) Ecups Ecups cups cups i R Hc0 Hc0 HR).
  Qed.

Neutrals

The member mref references has as many uniform parameters as the member's own (im_unu): the group's at a declared member, the container's at a view.
  Lemma im_unu_at_ref : forall k Mk hd k' pre D0, ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
      ⟦mref k of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k', pre) -> ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack hd = Some D0 ->
      im_unu D Mk = ind_nu D0.
  Proof.
    intros * HMk Hr HlD0.
    unfold im_unu; destruct (im_head Mk) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh;
      [| | exfalso; exact (mref_not_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hr) ].
    - pose proof (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMk Hh Hr) as E; injection E as -> -> ->.
      rewrite Hl in HlD0; injection HlD0 as <-; reflexivity.
    - destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMk Hh Hr) as (py & E & Epy); injection E as -> -> <-.
      destruct (decl_typed_view _ _ _ Hdt _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh) as (Dq & Mkc & Hq & _ & _ & HIsl & _).
      rewrite Hq in HlD0; injection HlD0 as <-; exact HIsl.
  Qed.

The non-uniform parameters of a member glued in the group, as the member mref references reads them: the parameters at im_pre glued at its values (the container's telescopes at a view, view_uparams_glu, view_nparams_glu), and related at its relation (view_nparams_rel).
  Lemma nparams_at_ref : forall k Mk hd k' pre D0 M0 Δ' Us' Ns0 ns0, ind_member D k = Some Mk ->
      ⟦mref k of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k', pre) -> ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack hd = Some D0 ->
      ind_member D0 k' = Some M0 -> ⊢ Δ' -> glu_args Δ' (ind_uparams D) Id nil Us' ups ->
      glu_nparams k Mk NEl Δ' Us' Ns0 ns0 -> tele_rel (nr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ns0 ns0 ->
      glu_args Δ' (im_params D0 M0) Id nil (im_pre Mk Us' ++ Ns0) (pre ++ ns0) /\
      tele_rel (canon_nparams_rel D0 pre k') (List.rev (im_nparams M0)) ns0 ns0.
  Proof.
    intros * HMk Hr HlD0 HM0 HΔ' HUs Hnp Hns.
    pose proof (glu_args_of_nparams D ups u NP NEl AP AEl DP DEl Hf k Mk Δ' Us' Ns0 ns0 HMk Hnp Hns) as HgN.
    destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ HUs) as [HUl _].
    destruct (im_head Mk) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; [| | exfalso; exact (mref_not_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hr) ].
    - pose proof (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMk Hh Hr) as E; injection E as -> -> ->.
      rewrite Hl in HlD0; injection HlD0 as <-; rewrite HMk in HM0; injection HM0 as <-.
      unfold im_pre; rewrite Hh.
      split; [| exact Hns ].
      unfold im_params; apply glu_args_app; [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) | exact HUl | rewrite Hu; reflexivity |].
      split; [ exact HUs | exact HgN ].
    - destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMk Hh Hr) as (py & E & Epy); injection E as -> -> <-.
      destruct (decl_typed_view _ _ _ Hdt _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh) as (Dq & Mkc & Hq & HMkc & _ & HIsl & _ & Hvk & _).
      rewrite Hq in HlD0; injection HlD0 as <-; rewrite HMkc in HM0; injection HM0 as <-.
      pose proof (valid_groups_containers VP HVP p D k Mk qc kc Is vm Dq HPD HMk Hh Hq) as HPq.
      pose proof (HGall _ _ HPq) as HGq.
      pose proof (valid_group_closed _ _ (valid_groups_valid VP HVP qc Dq HPq)) as HcQ.
      unfold im_pre; rewrite Hh.
      split.
      + unfold im_params; apply glu_args_app;
          [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ HcQ) | rewrite List.length_map; exact HIsl | rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Epy); exact HIsl |].
        split; [ exact (view_uparams_glu VP p D HVP HPD HG Hselfs k Mk qc kc Is vm Dq HMk Hh Hq HGq Δ' Us' ups pre HΔ' HUs Epy)
               | exact (view_nparams_glu VP p D HVP HPD HG Hselfs k Mk qc kc Is vm Dq HMk Hh Hq HGq Δ' Us' Ns0 ups ns0 pre kc Mkc k Mk
                          HΔ' Hu HUs HMkc Hvk HMk HgN Epy) ].
      + exact (nparams_rel_to_container VP p D HVP HPD ups Hu Hgu k Mk qc kc Is vm Dq pre kc Mkc k Mk HMk Hh Hq Epy HMkc Hvk HMk
                 ns0 ns0 Hns).
  Qed.

A neutral glued in the group, its annotation's non-uniform parameters X glued from some NsX, is glued at any gluing of its type: at the referenced member's clause, by its readback, its annotation's parameters glued there at any parameters Ps' of the type (nparams_at_ref): the type's own parameters are the group's (glu_params_top_eq), so the uniform ones are equal to Ps''s, and NsX moves to them (glu_args_resp_eq, nparams_of_glu_args).
  Lemma elem_at_neut : forall k Mk hd k' m Δ' Us' Ns' M' as', ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_is_rview Mk = false ->
      im_ref p k Mk = (hd, k') -> Dom m ≈ m ∈ per_bot ->
      (forall Δ φ M0, Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Δ' -> Rne m in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ length Δ ↘ M0 ->
         glu_ne_eq Δ M'[φ]ʷ M0 (im_ty_at p k Mk Us' Ns')[φ]ʷ) ->
      tele_rel (nr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) as') (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) as') ->
      (exists NsX, glu_nparams k Mk NEl Δ' Us' NsX (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) as')) ->
      elem_glu_at_type k Δ' Us' Ns' M' (⇑ (d_ind hd k' as') m).
  Proof.
    intros * HMk Hrv Href Hm Hrb HnrX [NsX HnpX] Mk0 ns hd0 k0 pre i P El HMk0 Hr HUs HM' Hgn Hns HGm Hglu HT.
    rewrite HMk in HMk0; injection HMk0 as <-.
    destruct (ViewReadback.mref_ref_len p D k Mk ups hd0 k0 pre Hl HMk Hu Hr) as [Href0 Lpre].
    rewrite Href in Href0; injection Href0 as <- <-.
    pose proof Hns as H0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in H0; destruct H0 as (Ln & _ & _).
    rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams in Ln.
    assert (HΔ' : ⊢ Δ') by (gen_presups; assumption).
    set (X := List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) as') in *.
The neutral, at its own annotation, is in the type's relation
    destruct (glu_univ_elem_per_univ _ _ _ _ Hglu) as [R HR].
    assert (HmR : R (⇑ (d_ind hd k' as') m) (⇑ (d_ind hd k' as') m))
      by (apply (mref_rel k Mk hd k' pre ns i R HMk Hr HR); exact HGm).
The type's clause is the referenced declared member's: the neutral is glued there by its readback, as ind_realize_bot glues it
    pose proof Hglu as Hglu'; invert_glu_univ_elem Hglu'.
    match goal with Hx : _ ++ _ = pre ++ ns |- _ => rewrite Hx in * end.
    match goal with
      H : ind_lookup _ _ hd = Some ?D0, H1 : ind_member ?D0 k' = Some ?M0, H2 : im_head ?M0 = mh_decl ?pm,
      H4 : per_univ_elem _ ?er (d_ind hd k' (pre ++ ns)) _,
      H11 : _ <∙> ind_glu_typ_pred _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, H12 : _ <∙> ind_glu_exp_pred _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
        rename H into HlD0, H1 into HM0, H2 into Hh0, H4 into HR0, H11 into HP0, H12 into HEl0
    end.
    match type of HM0 with ind_member ?d _ = Some ?mm => rename d into D0, mm into M0 end.
The clause's uniform values are pre
    pose proof (im_unu_at_ref k Mk hd k' pre _ HMk Hr HlD0) as Hunu.
    match goal with Hx : ?u0 ++ ?n0 = pre ++ ns, Hlu : List.length ?u0 = ind_nu _ |- _ =>
      destruct (app_split_eq _ _ _ _ Hx ltac:(congruence)) as [-> ->]
    end.
    match type of HP0 with _ <∙> ind_glu_typ_pred _ _ _ _ ?a1 ?a2 ?a3 ?a4 ?a5 ?a6 _ _ _ =>
      rename a1 into NP0, a2 into NEl0, a3 into AP0, a4 into AEl0, a5 into DP0, a6 into DEl0
    end.
    eassert (Hf0 : ind_fams_glu _ pre _ NP0 NEl0 AP0 AEl0 DP0 DEl0) by (constructor; eassumption).
    assert (Lpre0 : List.length pre = ind_nu D0) by (rewrite Lpre; exact Hunu).
    match goal with Hs0 : group_structure _ |- _ => rename Hs0 into Hass0 end.
    destruct (decl_of_lookup _ _ _ _ _ HΔ' HlD0) as [Hdt0 Hc0].
    pose proof (decl_closed_params_ass _ _ _ Hc0 HM0) as HassP0.
    pose proof (decl_closed_params _ _ _ Hc0 HM0) as HsP0.
The group's parameters and the annotation's, at the clause
    destruct (nparams_at_ref k Mk hd k' pre _ _ Δ' Us' Ns' ns HMk Hr HlD0 HM0 HΔ' HUs Hgn Hns) as [HgN _].
    destruct (nparams_at_ref k Mk hd k' pre _ _ Δ' Us' NsX X HMk Hr HlD0 HM0 HΔ' HUs HnpX HnrX) as [HgX HnrX0].
    assert (EX : List.skipn (im_unu _ M0) as' = X) by (unfold X, im_unu at 1; rewrite Hh0, Hunu; reflexivity).
    apply HEl0; pose proof HT as HT'; apply HP0 in HT'; destruct HT' as (Ps & HPs).
    refine (mk_ind_glu_exp _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM' _ Ps HPs _).
    { apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HR HR0); exact HmR. }
    intros Δ φ Ps' Hφ HPs'.
    assert (HΔ : ⊢ Δ) by (eapply kripke_dom; eassumption).
    pose proof (ind_typ_at_params_conv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ k' _ _ _ Δ' _ Ps Δ φ Ps' HlD0 HM0 Hh0 HPs Hφ HPs') as HPeq.
    pose proof HPs as [_ HPk]; destruct (HPk Δ φ Hφ) as [Hpt _ Hcs _].
The uniform parameters: the group's, at the clause, are the type's (glu_params_top_eq), so equal to Ps''s
    pose proof (glu_args_wk _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HassP0 HsP0 Hφ HgN) as HgNφ.
    pose proof (glu_args_wk _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HassP0 HsP0 Hφ HgX) as HgXφ.
    destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ HgN) as [LN _].
    destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ HgX) as [LX _].
    rewrite length_im_params in LN, LX.
    pose proof (glu_params_top_len _ _ _ _ _ Hpt) as LPs.
    destruct HPs' as [LPP HPP].
    assert (LUC : List.length (im_pre Mk Us') = ind_nu D0).
    { rewrite <- Hunu; destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ HUs) as [HUl _].
      unfold im_pre, im_unu; destruct (im_head Mk) eqn:Hh;
        [ exact HUl | rewrite List.length_map; reflexivity | unfold im_is_rview in Hrv; rewrite Hh in Hrv; discriminate ]. }
    pose proof (glu_params_top_eq _ _ _ _ Δ _ _ _ HlD0 HM0 HΔ (ind_rps_of_per _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HR0 HlD0 HM0 (length Δ))
                  (glu_args_params_top _ _ _ _ _ HassP0 HsP0 HgNφ) Hpt) as [_ E1].
    assert (E2 : exps_eq_at Δ (ind_uparams D0) (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) (im_pre Mk Us')) (List.firstn (ind_nu D0) Ps')).
    { assert (E1' : exps_eq_at Δ (im_params D0 M0) (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) (im_pre Mk Us' ++ Ns')) Ps').
      { split; [ rewrite List.length_map; congruence |].
        apply (params_eq_trans Δ hd D0 k' M0 (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) (im_pre Mk Us' ++ Ns')) (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) Ps) Ps'
                 HlD0 HM0 HΔ); [ rewrite List.length_map; exact LN | exact LPs | congruence | exact E1 | exact HPP ]. }
      pose proof (exps_eq_at_uparams_of_params _ _ _ _ _ Hc0 ltac:(rewrite List.length_map; exact LN) E1') as E3.
      rewrite List.map_app, firstn_app_exact in E3 by (rewrite List.length_map; exact LUC); exact E3. }
    
The annotation's parameters, at Ps''s uniform ones
    assert (E4 : exps_eq_at Δ (im_params D0 M0) (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) (im_pre Mk Us' ++ NsX))
                   (List.firstn (ind_nu D0) Ps' ++ List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) NsX)).
    { pose proof (exps_eq_at_params_of_uparams D0 M0 Δ (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) (im_pre Mk Us' ++ NsX)) (List.firstn (ind_nu D0) Ps') Hc0
                    ltac:(rewrite List.length_map; exact LX)
                    (glu_args_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ HassP0 HgXφ)
                    ltac:(rewrite List.map_app, firstn_app_exact by (rewrite List.length_map; exact LUC); exact E2)) as H.
      rewrite List.map_app, skipn_app_exact in H by (rewrite List.length_map; exact LUC); rewrite List.map_app; exact H. }
    pose proof (glu_args_resp_eq Δ _ nil _ _ _ HassP0 (member_params_wf _ _ _ _ _ Hdt0 HM0) HΔ E4 HgXφ) as HgX'.
    unfold im_params in HgX'; apply glu_args_app in HgX' as [_ HgXn];
      [| exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc0) | rewrite List.length_firstn; change (List.length (ind_uparams D0)) with (ind_nu D0);
                                          unfold im_np in LPs; lia | exact Lpre0 ].
    pose proof (nparams_of_glu_args hd D0 Hass0 pre _ NP0 NEl0 AP0 AEl0 DP0 DEl0 Lpre0 Hf0 k' M0 Δ (List.firstn (ind_nu D0) Ps')
                  (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) NsX) X HM0 (Hcs Ps' (conj LPP HPP)) HgXn HnrX0) as HnpX'.
    destruct HPs as [HAPs _].
    eapply ind_glu_elem_neut; [ exact HM0 | unfold im_is_rview; rewrite Hh0; reflexivity | unfold im_ref; rewrite Hh0; reflexivity
                              | exact Hm | | rewrite EX; exact HnrX0 | rewrite EX; eexists; exact HnpX' ].
    intros Θ ψ Mr Hψ Hrr.
    pose proof (kripke_compose _ _ _ _ _ Hψ Hφ) as Hcm.
    rewrite exp_wk_wk, (im_ty_at_decl _ _ _ _ _ _ Hh0), List.firstn_skipn.
    eapply glu_ne_eq_conv with (κ := ak_relevant); [| exact (Hrb _ _ _ Hcm Hrr) ]; cbn [abs_kind_sort].
    transitivity ((apps (a_ind hd k') (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) Ps))[ψ]ʷ); [| mauto 3 ].
    rewrite wk_apps_ind, map_wk_wk, <- wk_apps_ind; mauto 3.
  Qed.

The Value of a Member's Type over a Closed Telescope

The member j's type at the uniform parameters as variables, after values X ++ ws of a closed telescope Z over them related to themselves (X its non-uniform parameters): related to the type's value at the uniform parameters pre mref gives and non-uniform parameters related to X. The entries of a telescope at values split in two: those of the first part, then those of the second after them.
  Lemma tele_entries_split : forall X ws ρ T,
      tele_entries ρ T (X ++ ws) = tele_entries ρ T X ++ tele_entries (env_tele ρ T X) (List.skipn (List.length X) T) ws.
  Proof.
    induction X as [| x X IH]; intros ws ρ T; [ reflexivity |].
    cbn [List.app tele_entries List.length]; f_equal; rewrite IH.
    destruct T; [ cbn [List.tl]; rewrite !List.skipn_nil |]; reflexivity.
  Qed.

The non-uniform parameters as variables, past |ws| components: their values.
  Lemma eval_vars_from_components : forall T X ws,
      ⟦ vars_from (List.length ws) (List.length X) ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups T (X ++ ws) ↘ X.
  Proof.
    intros T X ws; unfold components_env, env_tele; rewrite tele_entries_split.
    pose proof (Decl.eval_vars_from_args (tele_entries (decl_env D ups) T X) (decl_env D ups)
                  (tele_entries (env_tele (decl_env D ups) T X) (List.skipn (List.length X) T) ws)) as H.
    rewrite tele_entries_values, !Decl.tele_entries_length in H; exact H.
  Qed.

  Lemma mty_val_rel : forall j Mj hd k' pre Z RZ X ws L b ns, ind_member D j = Some Mj ->
      ⟦mref j of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k', pre) ->
      ⊨ Z ++ ind_uparams D -> EF Z ++ ind_uparams D ≈ Z ++ ind_uparams D ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RZ ->
      List.length (X ++ ws) = List.length Z -> List.length X = im_nn Mj -> List.length ws = L ->
      RZ (components_env D ups (List.rev Z) (X ++ ws)) (components_env D ups (List.rev Z) (X ++ ws)) ->
      ⟦ ind_mty p D j (ind_uvars D (im_nn Mj) L) (vars_from L (im_nn Mj)) ⟧ components_env D ups (List.rev Z) (X ++ ws) ↘ b ->
      tele_rel (nr j) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) ns X ->
      exists (i0 : universe_index) R0, DF d_ind hd k' (pre ++ ns) ≈ b ∈ per_univ_elem i0 ↘ R0.
  Proof.
    intros * HMj Hr HZ HRZ Lz LX Lw HE Eb Hns.
    destruct (ViewReadback.mref_ref_len p D j Mj ups hd k' pre Hl HMj Hu Hr) as [Href _].
    destruct (eval_mty_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj (mref_rview_false _ _ _ HMj Hr) Eb) as (cs & xs & Ecs & Exs & ->).
    rewrite Href; cbn [fst snd].
    assert (EX : ⟦ vars_from L (im_nn Mj) ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups (List.rev Z) (X ++ ws) ↘ X)
      by (rewrite <- LX, <- Lw; apply eval_vars_from_components).
    pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Exs EX) as ->.
    destruct (im_head Mj) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; [| | exfalso; exact (mref_not_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Hr) ].
    - pose proof (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMj Hh Hr) as E; injection E as -> -> ->.
      assert (cs = ups) as ->.
      { unfold im_pre in Ecs; rewrite Hh in Ecs.
        assert (HU : ⟦ ind_uvars D (im_nn Mj) L ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups (List.rev Z) (X ++ ws) ↘ ups)
          by (apply eval_uvars_components; [ exact Hu | rewrite List.length_app; lia ]).
        exact (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Ecs HU). }
      destruct (valid_group_relate p D Hvg j Mj pm ups ups ns X HMj Hh Hgu Hu Hns) as [i0 Hi0]; eauto.
    - destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMj Hh Hr) as (py & E & Epy); injection E as -> -> <-.
      destruct (decl_typed_view _ _ _ Hdt _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh) as (Dq & Mkc & Hq & _).
      destruct (view_pre_values p D Hvg Hcv j Mj qc kc Is vm Dq ups Z RZ (X ++ ws) (im_nn Mj) L cs HMj Hh Hq Hu Hgu
                  HZ HRZ ltac:(lia) ltac:(rewrite List.length_app; lia) HE Ecs) as (cups & Ecups & Hgc).
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Ecups Epy) as ->.
      destruct (ViewReadback.view_end_type VP HVP p D HPD ups Hgu Hu j Mj qc kc Is vm Dq pre cs ns X HMj Hh Hq Epy Hgc
                  ltac:(unfold nparams_tele_rel; rewrite HMj; exact Hns)) as (i0 & R0 & H0); eauto.
  Qed.

Types of Members at Glued Parameters

A level nb above the clause's index and the sorts of the containers of the views: at it and above, the type of a member at glued parameters is glued at its value's gluing.
  Variable (nb : nat).
  Hypotheses (Hnbu : universe_index_le u (ul nb))
    (Hnbq : forall j Mj qc kc Is vm Dq, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_head Mj = mh_view qc kc Is vm ->
              ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some Dq -> forall ρ bq, ⟦ ind_sort Dq ⟧ ρ ↘ bq ->
              universe_index_le (Completeness.Inductives.Decl.univ_idx bq) (ul nb))
    
... and above the sorts of the records of the record views
    (Hnbr : forall j Mj qr Is fl R, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_head Mj = mh_record qr Is fl ->
              record_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qr = Some R -> forall ρ b, ⟦ record_sort R ⟧ ρ ↘ b ->
              universe_index_le (Completeness.Inductives.Decl.univ_idx b) (ul nb)).

  Lemma ul_mono : forall a b, a <= b -> universe_index_le (ul a) (ul b).
  Proof. intros a b Hab; apply universe_index_le_ul_max; cbn; exact Hab. Qed.

  Lemma mty_glu : forall j Mj hd k' pre Δ Us' Q bs (i : nat) P El, nb <= i -> ind_member D j = Some Mj ->
      ⟦mref j of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k', pre) -> ⊢ Δ ->
      glu_args Δ (ind_uparams D) Id nil Us' ups -> glu_nparams j Mj NEl Δ Us' Q bs ->
      tele_rel (nr j) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) bs bs ->
      DG d_ind hd k' (pre ++ bs) ∈ glu_univ_elem i ↘ P ↘ El -> Δ ⊢ im_ty_at p j Mj Us' Q ® P.
  Proof.
    intros * Hi HMj Hr HΔ HUs Hgn Hbs Hglu.
    pose proof (glu_nparams_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hgn) as LQ.
    pose proof (glu_nparams_vals_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hgn) as Lbs.
    destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ HUs) as [LU _].
    pose proof (glu_args_of_nparams D ups u NP NEl AP AEl DP DEl Hf j Mj Δ Us' Q bs HMj Hgn Hbs) as HNs.
    destruct (glu_univ_elem_per_univ _ _ _ _ Hglu) as [R HR].
    destruct (im_head Mj) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; [| | exfalso; exact (mref_not_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Hr) ].
    - pose proof (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMj Hh Hr) as E; injection E as -> -> ->.
      assert (Hlt : j < ind_ndecl D) by (eapply decl_member_lt; eassumption).
      assert (HgP : glu_args Δ (im_params D Mj) Id nil (Us' ++ Q) (ups ++ bs)).
      { unfold im_params; apply glu_args_app; [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) | exact LU | rewrite Hu; reflexivity |].
        split; [ exact HUs | exact HNs ]. }
      destruct (ind_glu_of_per p D Hl (ul i) R j Mj pm ups bs HMj Hh HR Hu)
        as [NP2 NEl2 AP2 AEl2 DP2 DEl2 P2 El2 R2 Hg2 HP2 HEl2 HR2 Hf2].
      assert (Hle' : universe_index_le (Completeness.Inductives.Decl.univ_idx bu) (ul i))
        by (eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact Hule | eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact Hnbu | exact (ul_mono _ _ Hi) ] ]).
      assert (HT2 : Δ ⊢ im_ty_at p j Mj Us' Q ® P2).
      { apply HP2; exists (Us' ++ Q).
        unfold im_ty_at, im_ref, im_pre; rewrite Hh; cbn [fst snd].
        exact (ind_typ_at_of_args p D Hl HG Hc Hdt Hsu Hass j Mj Δ (Us' ++ Q) ups bs bu (ul i) NP2 NEl2 AP2 AEl2 DP2 DEl2
                 HMj Hlt HΔ HgP Hu Hbu Hle' Hf2 (Hselfs ups bu (ul i) NP2 NEl2 AP2 AEl2 DP2 DEl2 Hu Hgu Hbu Hle' Hf2) Hbs). }
      destruct (functional_glu_univ_elem _ _ _ _ _ _ Hglu Hg2) as [EP _].
      apply EP; exact HT2.
    - destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMj Hh Hr) as (py & E & Epy); injection E as -> -> <-.
      destruct (decl_typed_view _ _ _ Hdt _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh) as (Dq & Mkc & Hq & HMkc & Hkd & HIl & _ & Hvm & _).
      pose proof (valid_groups_containers VP HVP p D j Mj qc kc Is vm Dq HPD HMj Hh Hq) as HPq.
      pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HVP qc Dq HPq) as HgQ.
      pose proof (HGall _ _ HPq) as HGq.
      assert (Hhc : exists pmc, im_head Mkc = mh_decl pmc).
      { pose proof (proj2 (decl_typed_order _ _ _ (valid_group_typed _ _ HgQ) _ _ HMkc) Hkd) as Hd.
        unfold im_is_decl in Hd; destruct (im_head Mkc); [ eauto | discriminate | discriminate ]. }
      destruct Hhc as [pmc Hhc].
      assert (Hlpre : List.length pre = ind_nu Dq) by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Epy); exact HIl).
      pose proof (view_uparams_glu VP p D HVP HPD HG Hselfs j Mj qc kc Is vm Dq HMj Hh Hq HGq Δ Us' ups pre HΔ HUs Epy) as HUc.
      pose proof (view_nparams_glu VP p D HVP HPD HG Hselfs j Mj qc kc Is vm Dq HMj Hh Hq HGq Δ Us' Q ups bs pre kc Mkc j Mj HΔ Hu HUs
                    HMkc Hvm HMj HNs Epy) as HNc.
      pose proof (nparams_rel_to_container VP p D HVP HPD ups Hu Hgu j Mj qc kc Is vm Dq pre kc Mkc j Mj HMj Hh Hq Epy HMkc Hvm HMj
                    bs bs Hbs) as Hbsq.
      assert (HPc : glu_args Δ (im_params Dq Mkc) Id nil (List.map (fun I => I[sb_of_list Id Us']) Is ++ Q) (pre ++ bs)).
      { unfold im_params; apply glu_args_app; [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ)) | rewrite List.length_map; exact HIl
                                              | exact Hlpre |].
        split; [ exact HUc | exact HNc ]. }
      destruct (ind_glu_of_per qc Dq (valid_group_lookup _ _ HgQ) (ul i) R kc Mkc pmc pre bs HMkc Hhc HR Hlpre)
        as [NP2 NEl2 AP2 AEl2 DP2 DEl2 P2 El2 R2 Hg2 HP2 HEl2 HR2 Hf2].
      destruct (valid_group_views_view_args_values p D Hvg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Hq ups ups Hgu Hu) as (c0 & c0' & E0 & _ & Hc0).
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ E0 Epy) as ->.
      destruct (sort_value Dq (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ) pre ltac:(eapply uparams_refl_l; [ exact (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ)
                                                                                     | exact (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) | exact Hc0 ]) Hlpre)
        as [bq Ebq].
      assert (Hle' : universe_index_le (Completeness.Inductives.Decl.univ_idx bq) (ul i))
        by (eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact (Hnbq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Hq _ _ Ebq) | exact (ul_mono _ _ Hi) ]).
      assert (HT2 : Δ ⊢ im_ty_at p j Mj Us' Q ® P2).
      { apply HP2; exists (List.map (fun I => I[sb_of_list Id Us']) Is ++ Q).
        unfold im_ty_at, im_ref, im_pre; rewrite Hh; cbn [fst snd].
        exact (ind_typ_at_of_args qc Dq (valid_group_lookup _ _ HgQ) HGq (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) (valid_group_typed _ _ HgQ) (valid_group_sort _ _ HgQ)
                 (valid_group_ass _ _ HgQ) kc Mkc Δ _ pre bs bq (ul i) NP2 NEl2 AP2 AEl2 DP2 DEl2 HMkc Hkd HΔ HPc Hlpre Ebq Hle' Hf2
                 (HSall qc Dq HPq pre bq (ul i) NP2 NEl2 AP2 AEl2 DP2 DEl2 Hlpre
                    ltac:(eapply uparams_refl_l; [ exact (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ) | exact (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) | exact Hc0 ])
                    Ebq Hle' Hf2) Hbsq). }
      destruct (functional_glu_univ_elem _ _ _ _ _ _ Hglu Hg2) as [EP _].
      apply EP; exact HT2.
  Qed.

The type of a record view at glued uniform parameters, at and above nb: the record type at the view's instance, glued at its value's gluing, the record being glued (HRall).
  Lemma rview_mty_glu : forall j Mj qr Is fl cups Δ Us' (i : nat) P El, nb <= i -> ind_member D j = Some Mj ->
      im_head Mj = mh_record qr Is fl -> ⟦ Is ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env D ups ↘ cups -> ⊢ Δ ->
      glu_args Δ (ind_uparams D) Id nil Us' ups ->
      DG d_record qr cups ∈ glu_univ_elem i ↘ P ↘ El -> Δ ⊢ im_ty_at p j Mj Us' nil ® P.
  Proof.
    intros * Hi HMj Hh Ecups HΔ HUs Hglu.
    destruct (valid_group_records _ _ Hvg _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh) as [R HR].
    pose proof (valid_rview_record_lookup _ _ HR) as HlR.
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΔ) as Hgc.
    pose proof (HRall _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HPD HMj Hh HlR) as HGR.
    pose proof (rview_uparams_glu VP p D HVP HPD HG Hselfs j Mj qr Is fl R HMj Hh HR Δ Us' ups cups HΔ HUs Ecups) as HNs.
    pose proof (valid_rview_record_valid _ _ HR) as [HWR _ [is HS] _ _ _].
    destruct (Completeness.Records.Model.sort_tele_value (record_params R) (record_sort R) HWR (ex_intro _ is HS) cups
                (RviewEnds.rview_args_container_uparams_rel p D Hvg j Mj qr Is fl R HMj Hh HR ups cups Hgu Hu Ecups)
                (RviewEnds.rview_args_container_uparams_len p D Hvg j Mj qr Is fl R HMj Hh HR ups cups Ecups)) as [b Eb].
    assert (Hbi : universe_index_le (Completeness.Inductives.Decl.univ_idx b) i)
      by (eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact (Hnbr _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh HlR _ _ Eb) | exact (ul_mono _ _ Hi) ]).
    unfold im_ty_at, im_pre; rewrite Hh, List.app_nil_r.
    exact (Mctt.Core.Soundness.Records.Former.record_typ_glu qr R Hgc HlR HGR Δ _ cups b i P El HΔ HNs Eb Hbi Hglu).
  Qed.

Types of Recursive Arguments

The type of a recursive argument glued in the group, at a universe above nb and its type's: glued at the gluing of the value of its shape's type. A domain value's relation is the canonical family's at it.
  Lemma rel_dr : forall k pre Ts B b (j : universe_index) R c, ⟦ B ⟧ components_env D ups Ts pre ↘ b ->
      DF b ≈ b ∈ per_univ_elem j ↘ R -> R c c -> dr k pre Ts B c c.
  Proof.
    intros * Eb HR Hcc; unfold canon_doms_rel, per_head; intros i2 R1 b2 b2' Eb2 Eb2' HR1.
    assert (b2 = b) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
    assert (b2' = b) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
    apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HR HR1); exact Hcc.
  Qed.

  Lemma shape_ty_step : forall t Us' σs φ b, List.length Us' = ind_nu D ->
      (ptyp_ty_at p D (List.map (fun U => U[↑]ʷ) Us') (q σs) t)[(ι φ),,b]
      = ptyp_ty_at p D (List.map (fun U => U[φ]ʷ) Us') (q σs ⨟ ((ι φ),,b)) t.
  Proof.
    intros * HUl; rewrite ptyp_ty_at_sub by (try exact Hc; rewrite List.length_map; exact HUl).
    rewrite List.map_map; f_equal; apply List.map_ext; intros U; apply exp_shift_extend_wk.
  Qed.

The premises of glu_rec at each shape.
  Lemma glu_rec_self_inv : forall k Γ Us pre Ts j Ps A N v, glu_rec p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Γ Us pre Ts (pt_self j Ps) A N v ->
      exists Mj, ind_member D j = Some Mj /\
      (forall bsr Q, ⟦ Ps ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups Ts pre ↘ bsr ->
         A = im_ty_at p j Mj Us Q ->
         List.length Q = im_nn Mj /\ tele_rel (nr j) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) bsr bsr) /\
      (forall bsr Q, ⟦ Ps ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups Ts pre ↘ bsr ->
         A = im_ty_at p j Mj Us Q ->
         forall Δ φ Us' Q', Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Γ -> List.length Us' = ind_nu D ->
           exps_eq_at Δ (im_params D Mj) (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) (Us ++ Q)) (Us' ++ Q') ->
           ind_glu_elem p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl j Δ Us' Q' N[φ]ʷ v).
  Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

  Lemma glu_rec_pi_inv : forall k Γ Us pre Ts B t A N v, glu_rec p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Γ Us pre Ts (pt_pi B t) A N v ->
      (forall IT OT, A = a_pi ak_relevant ak_relevant IT OT -> forall Δ φ, Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Γ -> Δ ⊢ IT[φ]ʷ ® DP k pre Ts B) /\
      (forall IT OT, A = a_pi ak_relevant ak_relevant IT OT -> forall Δ φ b c, Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Γ -> dr k pre Ts B c c ->
         Δ ⊢ b : IT[φ]ʷ ® c ∈ DEl k pre Ts B -> exists fc, $| v & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ fc) /\
      (forall IT OT, A = a_pi ak_relevant ak_relevant IT OT -> forall Δ φ b c fc, Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Γ -> dr k pre Ts B c c ->
         Δ ⊢ b : IT[φ]ʷ ® c ∈ DEl k pre Ts B -> $| v & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ fc ->
         glu_rec p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Δ (List.map (fun U => U[φ]ʷ) Us) (pre ++ c :: nil) (Ts ++ ce_ass ak_relevant B :: nil) t
           OT[(ι φ),,b] (a_app N[φ]ʷ b) fc).
  Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

  Lemma eval_shape_type_pi_inv : forall B t ρ a, ⟦shty pt_pi B t of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ a ->
      exists b, ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↘ b /\ a = Πᵈ{ak_relevant} b (nil ↦ d_shfam p ups ρ B t ⦂ entry_type_none) fam_cod.
  Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

The type of a shape ending in a member that is not a record view.
  Lemma eval_shape_type_self_inv : forall j Mj Ps ρ a, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mj = false ->
      ⟦shty pt_self j Ps of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ a ->
      exists bs pc kc pre, ⟦ Ps ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ bs /\ ⟦mref j of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (pc, kc, pre) /\
        a = d_ind pc kc (pre ++ bs).
  Proof.
    intros * HMj Hrv H; inversion H; subst; [ eauto 10 |].
    match goal with H1 : ind_lookup _ _ p = Some ?D', H2 : ind_member ?D' j = Some ?M', H3 : im_head ?M' = mh_record _ _ _ |- _ =>
      rewrite Hl in H1; injection H1 as <-; rewrite HMj in H2; injection H2 as <-; exfalso; exact (not_rview_record _ _ _ _ Hrv H3) end.
  Qed.

The type of a shape ending in a record view: the record type at the view's instance at ups.
  Lemma eval_shape_type_rview_inv : forall j Mj qr Is fl Ps ρ a, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_head Mj = mh_record qr Is fl ->
      ⟦shty pt_self j Ps of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ a ->
      exists cups, ⟦ Is ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env D ups ↘ cups /\ a = d_record qr cups.
  Proof.
    intros * HMj Hh H; inversion H; subst; [ exfalso; eapply mref_not_rview; eassumption |].
    match goal with H1 : ind_lookup _ _ p = Some ?D', H2 : ind_member ?D' j = Some ?M', H3 : im_head ?M' = mh_record _ _ _ |- _ =>
      rewrite Hl in H1; injection H1 as <-; rewrite HMj in H2; injection H2 as <-; rewrite Hh in H3; injection H3 as <- <- <- end.
    eauto.
  Qed.

The components at the first domains of a shape are those at all of them.
  Lemma shape_comps_env_full : forall Mk gs1 t0 d ms ws ys, List.length ms = im_nn Mk ->
      List.length ws = List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1) -> List.length ys <= d -> d <= List.length (ptyp_doms t0) ->
      components_env D ups (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn d (shape_doms_tele t0)) (ms ++ ws ++ ys)
      = components_env D ups (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ shape_doms_tele t0) (ms ++ ws ++ ys).
  Proof.
    intros * Hms Hws Hys Hd; rewrite !List.app_assoc.
    apply components_env_app_firstn_ge;
      [ exact Hu | rewrite !List.length_app, List.length_rev, length_im_nparams, length_cargs_nonrec_tele; lia | exact Hys
      | unfold shape_doms_tele; rewrite List.length_map; lia ].
  Qed.

The telescope of the components, one domain further.
  Lemma shape_tele_snoc : forall (Mk : imember) (gs1 : list carg) (t0 : ptyp) d B, List.nth_error (ptyp_doms t0) d = Some B ->
      (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn d (shape_doms_tele t0)) ++ ce_ass ak_relevant B :: nil
      = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn (S d) (shape_doms_tele t0).
  Proof.
    intros * HB.
    assert (Hsd : List.nth_error (shape_doms_tele t0) d = Some (ce_ass ak_relevant B))
      by (unfold shape_doms_tele; rewrite List.nth_error_map, HB; reflexivity).
    rewrite (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ Hsd), <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity.
  Qed.

A type glued along a shape (glu_shape_typ) is glued at the value of the shape's type, at and above nb.
  Lemma rec_typ_glu : forall t k Δ' Us' pre Ts A,
      glu_shape_typ (dr k) (DP k) (DEl k) (glu_self_params p D ups NEl) Δ' Us' pre Ts t A ->
      forall Mk ms c0 gs1 t0 gs2 ws d ys σs a (j0 i : nat) P El,
      ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c0 = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t0 :: gs2) -> pre = ms ++ ws ++ ys ->
      Ts = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn d (shape_doms_tele t0) ->
      tele_rel (nr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ms ms ->
      tele_prefix_rel (ar k ms c0) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws ->
      ptyp_skip d t0 = t ->
      tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (dr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) d ys ys ->
      glu_args Δ' (ind_uparams D) Id nil Us' ups -> A = ptyp_ty_at p D Us' σs t -> Δ' ⊢ A : Typeω@j0 ->
      ⟦shty t of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups Ts pre ↘ a -> j0 <= i -> nb <= i ->
      DG a ∈ glu_univ_elem i ↘ P ↘ El -> Δ' ⊢ A ® P.
  Proof.
    induction t as [j Ps | B t IH]; intros * Hgr * HMk Hc0 Hpre HTs Hms Hws Hsk Hys HUs HA HAt Ea Hj0 Hi Hglu.
    all: assert (HΔ' : ⊢ Δ') by (gen_presups; assumption).
    all: destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ HUs) as [LU _].
    - subst; cbn [glu_shape_typ] in Hgr.
      destruct (valid_ind_decl_params_length _ HD k Mk c0 _ HMk Hc0 gs1 t0 gs2 eq_refl) as (Mj & HMj & _).
      rewrite <- (ptyp_mem_skip d t0), Hsk in HMj; cbn [ptyp_mem] in HMj.
      destruct (im_is_rview Mj) eqn:Hrv.
      {
A record view: the record type at the view's instance.
        destruct (im_head Mj) as [| | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; unfold im_is_rview in Hrv; rewrite Hh in Hrv; try discriminate.
        destruct (eval_shape_type_rview_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Ea) as (cups & Ecups & ->).
        destruct (valid_ind_decl_params_length _ HD k Mk c0 _ HMk Hc0 gs1 t0 gs2 eq_refl) as (Mj' & HMj' & HPl).
        rewrite <- (ptyp_mem_skip d t0), <- (ptyp_ps_skip d t0), Hsk in *; cbn [ptyp_mem ptyp_ps] in HMj', HPl.
        rewrite HMj in HMj'; injection HMj' as <-.
        rewrite (RviewEnds.rview_args_nn p D Hvg j Mj qr Is fl HMj Hh) in HPl.
        destruct Ps; [| discriminate HPl ].
        cbn [ptyp_ty_at List.map]; unfold ind_mty; rewrite HMj.
        exact (rview_mty_glu j Mj qr Is fl cups Δ' Us' i P El Hi HMj Hh Ecups HΔ' HUs Hglu). }
      destruct (eval_shape_type_self_inv _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hrv Ea) as (bs & pc & kc & pre' & Ebs & Hr & ->).
      destruct (Hgr Mj (List.map (fun P0 => P0[σs]) Ps) bs HMj
                  ltac:(cbn [ptyp_ty_at]; unfold ind_mty; rewrite HMj; reflexivity) Ebs) as [Hbs Hgn _].
      cbn [ptyp_ty_at]; unfold ind_mty; rewrite HMj.
      exact (mty_glu j Mj _ _ _ Δ' Us' _ _ i P El Hi HMj Hr HΔ' HUs Hgn Hbs Hglu).
    - subst pre A Ts; cbn [glu_shape_typ] in Hgr.
      destruct (Tele.ptyp_skip_pi _ _ _ _ Hsk) as [HB Hsk'].
      cbn [ptyp_ty_at] in HAt, Hgr |- *.
      set (IT := B[σs]) in *.
      set (OTy := ptyp_ty_at p D (List.map (fun U => U[↑]ʷ) Us') (q σs) t) in *.
      destruct (Hgr _ _ eq_refl) as [Hq1 Hq3].
      destruct (eval_shape_type_pi_inv _ _ _ _ Ea) as (b1 & Eb1 & ->).
      destruct (glu_univ_elem_per_univ _ _ _ _ Hglu) as [Ra HRa].
      basic_invert_per_univ_elem HRa.
      match goal with H : forall (c c' : domain) (_ : ?ir c c'), rel_mod_eval _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename H into Hcod end.
      destruct (glu_univ_elem_pi_clean_inversion1 equiv_a_a' ltac:(constructor) Hglu)
        as (IP & IEl & OP & OEl & erel & Hgb1 & Hcodg & Hper & HPeq & _).
The lengths of the components, and the domain's value at all the shape's domains.
      pose proof Hms as Hlm; rewrite tele_rel_iff in Hlm; destruct Hlm as (Hlm & _ & _).
      rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams in Hlm.
      pose proof Hws as Hlw; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hlw; destruct Hlw as (Hlw & _ & _).
      pose proof Hys as Hly; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hly; destruct Hly as (Hly & _ & _).
      assert (Hdl : d < List.length (ptyp_doms t0)) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
      pose proof Eb1 as Eb1f.
      rewrite (shape_comps_env_full Mk gs1 t0 d ms ws ys Hlm Hlw ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia)) in Eb1f.
      pose proof (ind_fams_glu_dom_glu _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hms Hc0 eq_refl Hws HB Hys Eb1f) as HgD.
      destruct (wf_pi_inversion' HAt) as [HITt HOTt].
      assert (Hui : universe_index_le u (ul i)) by (eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact Hnbu | exact (ul_mono _ _ Hi) ]).
      apply HPeq; econstructor.
      + apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact (lift_exp_ge _ _ _ _ j0 i Hj0 HAt).
      + exact (lift_exp_ge _ _ _ _ j0 i Hj0 HITt).
      + exact (lift_exp_ge _ _ _ _ j0 i Hj0 HOTt).
      +
The domain's gluing at the clause, at the larger universe: the same value
        intros Δ φ Hφ.
        exact (glu_univ_elem_typ_cumu_ge_universe_index Hui HgD Hgb1 (Hq1 _ _ Hφ)).
      + intros Δ φ M m Hφ HM equiv_m.
        pose proof (rel_dr k (ms ++ ws ++ ys) _ B b1 i in_rel m Eb1 equiv_a_a' equiv_m) as Hdr.
        assert (HbD : Δ ⊢ M : IT[φ]ʷ ® m ∈ DEl k (ms ++ ws ++ ys)
                                 (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn d (shape_doms_tele t0)) B).
        { eapply glu_elem_retype; [ exact Hgb1 | exact HgD | exact (glu_univ_elem_trm_typ _ _ _ _ Hgb1 _ _ _ _ HM) | exact HM
                                  | exact (Hq1 _ _ Hφ) ]. }
        pose proof (Hq3 _ _ _ _ Hφ Hdr HbD) as Hgr'.
        destruct (Hcod _ _ equiv_m) as [a2 a2' Ea2 Ea2' _].
        pose proof (Hcodg _ equiv_m _ Ea2) as Hga2.
        pose proof (eval_fam_cod_shfam_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ea2) as Ea2s.
        assert (HΔ : ⊢ Δ) by (eapply kripke_dom; exact Hφ).
        pose proof (glu_univ_elem_trm_escape _ _ _ _ Hgb1 _ _ _ _ HM) as HMt.
        rewrite (shape_tele_snoc Mk gs1 t0 d B HB), <- !List.app_assoc in Hgr'; cbn [List.app] in Hgr'.
        assert (HlT : List.length (ms ++ ws ++ ys)
                      = List.length (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn d (shape_doms_tele t0)))
          by (rewrite !List.length_app, List.length_rev, length_im_nparams, length_cargs_nonrec_tele, List.length_firstn;
              unfold shape_doms_tele; rewrite List.length_map; lia).
        assert (Ea2c : ⟦shty t of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮
                         components_env D ups (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn (S d) (shape_doms_tele t0))
                           (ms ++ ws ++ ys ++ m :: nil) ↘ a2).
        { rewrite <- (shape_tele_snoc Mk gs1 t0 d B HB).
          replace (ms ++ ws ++ ys ++ m :: nil) with ((ms ++ ws ++ ys) ++ m :: nil) by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
          rewrite (Comps.components_env_snoc D ups Hu) by exact HlT; exact Ea2s. }
        eapply (IH k Δ (List.map (fun U => U[φ]ʷ) Us') _ _ _ Hgr' Mk ms c0 gs1 t0 gs2 ws (S d) (ys ++ m :: nil)
                  (q σs ⨟ ((ι φ),,M)) a2 j0 i); try eassumption.
        * reflexivity.
        * reflexivity.
        * apply tele_prefix_rel_snoc; [ exact Hys |]; unfold shape_doms_rel; rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HB); exact Hdr.
        * exact (glu_args_wk _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) (decl_closed_uparams _ Hc) Hφ HUs).
        * unfold OTy; apply shape_ty_step; rewrite LU; reflexivity.
        * exact (sub_typ_extend _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HITt HOTt Hφ HMt).
  Qed.

Recursive Arguments

At the end of a shape, the argument is an element of the member the shape ends in, glued at its type by the induction.
  Lemma rec_at_self : forall j Mj Ps Ts pre A Us Γ N v k, ind_member D j = Some Mj ->
      (forall bsr Q, ⟦ Ps ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups Ts pre ↘ bsr -> A = im_ty_at p j Mj Us Q ->
         List.length Q = im_nn Mj /\ tele_rel (nr j) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) bsr bsr) ->
      (forall bsr Q, ⟦ Ps ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups Ts pre ↘ bsr -> A = im_ty_at p j Mj Us Q ->
         forall Δ φ Us' Q', Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Γ -> List.length Us' = ind_nu D ->
           exps_eq_at Δ (im_params D Mj) (List.map (fun P => P[φ]ʷ) (Us ++ Q)) (Us' ++ Q') ->
           elem_glu_at_type j Δ Us' Q' N[φ]ʷ v /\ rview_glu_at_type j Δ Us' Q' N[φ]ʷ v) ->
      rec_glu_at_type k Γ Us pre Ts (pt_self j Ps) A N v.
  Proof.
    intros * HMj Hs1 IH; unfold rec_glu_at_type.
    intros Mk ms c0 gs1 t0 gs2 ws d ys σs a i P El HMk Hc0 Hpre HTs Hms Hws Hsk Hys HUs HA Hst HN Ea HRv Hglu HAP.
    cbn [glu_shape_typ] in Hst.
    assert (HΓ : ⊢ Γ) by (gen_presups; assumption).
    pose proof (kripke_id _ HΓ) as Hid.
    destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ HUs) as [LU _].
    destruct (im_is_rview Mj) eqn:Hrv.
    {
At a record view: the record type at the view's instance.
      destruct (im_head Mj) as [| | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; unfold im_is_rview in Hrv; rewrite Hh in Hrv; try discriminate.
      destruct (eval_shape_type_rview_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Ea) as (cups & Ecups & ->).
      destruct (valid_ind_decl_params_length _ HD k Mk c0 _ HMk Hc0 gs1 t0 gs2 eq_refl) as (Mj' & HMj' & HPl).
      rewrite <- (ptyp_mem_skip d t0), Hsk in HMj'; rewrite <- (ptyp_ps_skip d t0), Hsk in HPl.
      cbn [ptyp_mem ptyp_ps] in HMj', HPl.
      rewrite HMj in HMj'; injection HMj' as <-.
      rewrite (RviewEnds.rview_args_nn p D Hvg j Mj qr Is fl HMj Hh) in HPl.
      destruct Ps; [| discriminate HPl ].
      assert (HAQ : A = im_ty_at p j Mj Us nil) by (rewrite HA; cbn [ptyp_ty_at List.map]; unfold ind_mty; rewrite HMj; reflexivity).
      assert (Ebs : ⟦ nil ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D ups Ts pre ↘ nil) by constructor.
      destruct (Hst Mj nil nil HMj HAQ Ebs) as [_ _ Htop].
      pose proof (IH _ _ Ebs HAQ Γ wk_id Us nil Hid LU
                    ltac:(pose proof (glu_params_top_refl _ _ _ _ _ (Htop _ _ Hid)) as H; rewrite map_wk_id in H;
                          rewrite map_wk_id; exact H)) as [_ He].
      rewrite exp_wk_id in He.
      destruct (glu_univ_elem_per_univ _ _ _ _ Hglu) as [R HR].
      pose proof (proj1 (rview_rel j Mj qr Is fl cups i R HMj Hh Ecups HR v v) (HRv _ HR)) as HGv.
      rewrite HAQ in HN, HAP |- *.
      exact (He Mj qr Is fl cups i P El HMj Hh Ecups HUs HN HGv Hglu HAP). }
    destruct (eval_shape_type_self_inv _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hrv Ea) as (bs & pc & kc & pre' & Ebs & Hr & ->).
    assert (HAQ : A = im_ty_at p j Mj Us (List.map (fun P0 => P0[σs]) Ps))
      by (rewrite HA; cbn [ptyp_ty_at]; unfold ind_mty; rewrite HMj; reflexivity).
    destruct (Hst Mj _ bs HMj HAQ Ebs) as [Hbs Hgn' Htop].
    pose proof (IH _ _ Ebs HAQ Γ wk_id Us (List.map (fun P0 => P0[σs]) Ps) Hid LU
                  ltac:(pose proof (glu_params_top_refl _ _ _ _ _ (Htop _ _ Hid)) as H; rewrite map_wk_id in H;
                        rewrite map_wk_id; exact H)) as [He _].
    rewrite exp_wk_id in He.
    destruct (glu_univ_elem_per_univ _ _ _ _ Hglu) as [R HR].
    pose proof (proj1 (mref_rel j Mj pc kc pre' bs i R HMj Hr HR v v) (HRv _ HR)) as HGv.
    rewrite HAQ in HN, HAP |- *.
    exact (He Mj bs pc kc pre' i P El HMj Hr HUs HN Hgn' Hbs HGv Hglu HAP).
  Qed.

At a domain of a shape, the argument is a function of the domain, glued at the Π by the induction at the rest of the shape.
  Lemma rec_at_pi : forall A Γ k pre Ts B v Us t N,
      (forall IT OT, A = a_pi ak_relevant ak_relevant IT OT -> forall Δ φ, Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Γ -> Δ ⊢ IT[φ]ʷ ® DP k pre Ts B) ->
      (forall IT OT, A = a_pi ak_relevant ak_relevant IT OT -> forall Δ φ b c, Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Γ -> dr k pre Ts B c c ->
         Δ ⊢ b : IT[φ]ʷ ® c ∈ DEl k pre Ts B -> exists fc, $| v & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ fc) ->
      (forall IT OT, A = a_pi ak_relevant ak_relevant IT OT -> forall Δ φ b c fc, Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Γ -> dr k pre Ts B c c ->
         Δ ⊢ b : IT[φ]ʷ ® c ∈ DEl k pre Ts B -> $| v & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ fc ->
         glu_rec p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Δ (List.map (fun U => U[φ]ʷ) Us) (pre ++ c :: nil) (Ts ++ ce_ass ak_relevant B :: nil) t
           OT[(ι φ),,b] (a_app N[φ]ʷ b) fc) ->
      (forall IT OT, A = a_pi ak_relevant ak_relevant IT OT -> forall Δ φ b c fc, Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Γ -> dr k pre Ts B c c ->
         Δ ⊢ b : IT[φ]ʷ ® c ∈ DEl k pre Ts B -> $| v & c | gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ fc ->
         rec_glu_at_type k Δ (List.map (fun U => U[φ]ʷ) Us) (pre ++ c :: nil) (Ts ++ ce_ass ak_relevant B :: nil) t
           OT[(ι φ),,b] (a_app N[φ]ʷ b) fc) ->
      rec_glu_at_type k Γ Us pre Ts (pt_pi B t) A N v.
  Proof.
    intros * Hq1 Hq2 Hq3 IH; unfold rec_glu_at_type.
    intros Mk ms c0 gs1 t0 gs2 ws d ys σs a i P El HMk Hc0 Hpre HTs Hms Hws Hsk Hys HUs HA Hst HN Ea HRv Hglu HAP.
    subst pre A Ts.
    destruct (Tele.ptyp_skip_pi _ _ _ _ Hsk) as [HB Hsk'].
    cbn [ptyp_ty_at glu_shape_typ] in Hq1, Hq2, Hq3, IH, HN, HAP, Hst |- *.
    destruct (Hst _ _ eq_refl) as [_ Hst'].
    set (IT := B[σs]) in *.
    set (OTy := ptyp_ty_at p D (List.map (fun U => U[↑]ʷ) Us) (q σs) t) in *.
    specialize (Hq1 _ _ eq_refl); specialize (Hq2 _ _ eq_refl); specialize (Hq3 _ _ eq_refl); specialize (IH _ _ eq_refl).
    destruct (eval_shape_type_pi_inv _ _ _ _ Ea) as (b1 & Eb1 & ->).
    assert (HΓ : ⊢ Γ) by (gen_presups; assumption).
    destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ HUs) as [LU _].
At a universe above the clause's and nb.
    set (L := Nat.max i nb).
    assert (HiL : universe_index_le i (ul L)) by (apply universe_index_le_ul_max; unfold L; cbn; lia).
    assert (HuL : universe_index_le u (ul L)) by (eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact Hnbu | apply ul_mono; unfold L; lia ]).
    destruct (glu_univ_elem_cumu_ge_universe_index HiL Hglu) as (PL & ElL & HgL).
    pose proof (glu_univ_elem_typ_cumu_ge_universe_index HiL Hglu HgL HAP) as HAPL.
    enough (HNL : Γ ⊢ N : Π{ak_relevant} IT OTy ® v ∈ ElL)
      by (eapply glu_elem_retype; [ exact HgL | exact Hglu | exact HAPL | exact HNL | exact HAP ]).
    destruct (glu_univ_elem_per_univ _ _ _ _ Hglu) as [R0 HR0].
    destruct (glu_univ_elem_per_univ _ _ _ _ HgL) as [RL HRL].
    assert (HRvL : RL v v).
    { apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (per_univ_elem_cumu_universe_index _ _ _ _ HR0 _ HiL) HRL).
      exact (HRv _ HR0). }
    pose proof HRL as HRsave.
    basic_invert_per_univ_elem HRL.
    match goal with H : forall (c c' : domain) (_ : ?ir c c'), rel_mod_eval _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename H into Hcod end.
    match goal with H : _ <~> pi_elements _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename H into HRE end.
    destruct (glu_univ_elem_pi_clean_inversion1 equiv_a_a' ltac:(constructor) HgL)
      as (IP & IEl & OP & OEl & erel & Hgb1 & Hcodg & Hper & HPeq & HEleq).
    pose proof Hms as Hlm; rewrite tele_rel_iff in Hlm; destruct Hlm as (Hlm & _ & _).
    rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams in Hlm.
    pose proof Hws as Hlw; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hlw; destruct Hlw as (Hlw & _ & _).
    pose proof Hys as Hly; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hly; destruct Hly as (Hly & _ & _).
    assert (Hdl : d < List.length (ptyp_doms t0)) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
    pose proof Eb1 as Eb1f.
    rewrite (shape_comps_env_full Mk gs1 t0 d ms ws ys Hlm Hlw ltac:(lia) ltac:(lia)) in Eb1f.
    pose proof (ind_fams_glu_dom_glu _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hms Hc0 eq_refl Hws HB Hys Eb1f) as HgD.
    pose proof (glu_univ_elem_univ_lvl_gen _ _ _ _ HgL ltac:(discriminate) _ _ HAPL) as HTyt; cbn [large_level domain_kind abs_kind_sort] in HTyt.
    destruct (wf_pi_inversion' HTyt) as [HITt HOTt].
The domain's gluing at the clause, at the larger universe: the same value
    assert (HIT : forall Δ φ, Δ ⊢ᵏ φ : Γ -> Δ ⊢ IT[φ]ʷ ® IP)
      by (intros Δ φ Hφ; exact (glu_univ_elem_typ_cumu_ge_universe_index HuL HgD Hgb1 (Hq1 _ _ Hφ))).
    apply HEleq; eapply mk_pi_glu_exp_pred with (IT := IT) (OT := OTy);
      [ exact HN | apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRsave Hper); exact HRvL
      | apply wf_exp_eq_refl; exact HTyt | exact HITt | exact HOTt | exact HIT |].
    intros Δ φ N0 n Hφ HN0 equiv_n.
    pose proof (rel_dr k (ms ++ ws ++ ys) _ B b1 (ul L) in_rel n Eb1 equiv_a_a' equiv_n) as Hdr.
    assert (HbD : Δ ⊢ N0 : IT[φ]ʷ ® n ∈ DEl k (ms ++ ws ++ ys)
                             (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn d (shape_doms_tele t0)) B).
    { eapply glu_elem_retype; [ exact Hgb1 | exact HgD | exact (glu_univ_elem_trm_typ _ _ _ _ Hgb1 _ _ _ _ HN0) | exact HN0
                              | exact (Hq1 _ _ Hφ) ]. }
    destruct (Hq2 _ _ _ _ Hφ Hdr HbD) as [fc Efc].
    pose proof (Hq3 _ _ _ _ _ Hφ Hdr HbD Efc) as Hgr'.
    pose proof (IH _ _ _ _ _ Hφ Hdr HbD Efc) as IH'.
    pose proof (Hst' _ _ _ _ Hφ Hdr HbD) as Hst''.
    destruct (Hcod _ _ equiv_n) as [a2 a2' Ea2 Ea2' Ha22].
    assert (a2' = a2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
    pose proof (Hcodg _ equiv_n _ Ea2) as Hga2.
    pose proof (eval_fam_cod_shfam_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ea2) as Ea2s.
    assert (HlT : List.length (ms ++ ws ++ ys)
                  = List.length (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn d (shape_doms_tele t0)))
      by (rewrite !List.length_app, List.length_rev, length_im_nparams, length_cargs_nonrec_tele, List.length_firstn;
          unfold shape_doms_tele; rewrite List.length_map; lia).
    assert (Ea2s' : ⟦shty t of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮
                      components_env D ups (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn (S d) (shape_doms_tele t0))
                        (ms ++ ws ++ ys ++ n :: nil) ↘ a2).
    { rewrite <- (shape_tele_snoc Mk gs1 t0 d B HB).
      replace (ms ++ ws ++ ys ++ n :: nil) with ((ms ++ ws ++ ys) ++ n :: nil) by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      rewrite (Comps.components_env_snoc D ups Hu) by exact HlT; exact Ea2s. }
    rewrite (shape_tele_snoc Mk gs1 t0 d B HB) in Hgr', IH', Hst''.
    destruct (pi_elements_app _ _ _ _ _ _ (proj1 (HRE v v) HRvL) _ _ equiv_n) as [fc1 fc2 Efc1 Efc2 Hfc].
    assert (fc1 = fc) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_app; eassumption).
    assert (fc2 = fc) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_app; eassumption).
    assert (HΔ : ⊢ Δ) by (eapply kripke_dom; exact Hφ).
    pose proof (glu_univ_elem_trm_escape _ _ _ _ Hgb1 _ _ _ _ HN0) as HN0t.
    pose proof (sub_typ_extend _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HITt HOTt Hφ HN0t) as HOTt'.
    assert (Hys' : tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (dr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t0) (S d)
                     (ys ++ n :: nil) (ys ++ n :: nil))
      by (apply tele_prefix_rel_snoc; [ exact Hys |]; unfold shape_doms_rel; rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HB); exact Hdr).
    assert (HUs' : glu_args Δ (ind_uparams D) Id nil (List.map (fun U => U[φ]ʷ) Us) ups)
      by exact (glu_args_wk _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) (decl_closed_uparams _ Hc) Hφ HUs).
    assert (HOTe : OTy[(ι φ),,N0] = ptyp_ty_at p D (List.map (fun U => U[φ]ʷ) Us) (q σs ⨟ ((ι φ),,N0)) t)
      by (unfold OTy; apply shape_ty_step; rewrite LU; reflexivity).
    exists fc; split; [ exact Efc |].
    eapply (IH' Mk ms c0 gs1 t0 gs2 ws (S d) (ys ++ n :: nil) (q σs ⨟ ((ι φ),,N0)) a2 L); try eassumption.
    - rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity.
    - reflexivity.
    - exact (app_wk_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HN Hφ HN0t).
    - rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ea2s'.
    - intros R' HR'; apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ha22 HR'); exact Hfc.
    - eapply (rec_typ_glu t k Δ (List.map (fun U => U[φ]ʷ) Us) _ _ _ Hst'' Mk ms c0 gs1 t0 gs2 ws (S d) (ys ++ n :: nil)
                (q σs ⨟ ((ι φ),,N0)) a2 L L); try eassumption;
        [ rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity | reflexivity | rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; exact Ea2s' | lia | unfold L; lia ].
  Qed.

Constructors

The parameters and the arguments of a constructor of the member k, glued in the group, are glued at the closed telescope of its arguments: the non-recursive ones at the clause's families, the recursive ones by the induction, both against the telescope's types at the values before them, which the arguments before them relate.
  Section AtCon.
    Variables (k : nat) (Mk : imember) (c : String.string) (gs : list carg)
      (Us' Ns' : list exp) (X vs : list domain) (As : list exp) (Δ' : ctx).
    Hypotheses (HMk : ind_member D k = Some Mk) (Hcon : ind_con Mk c = Some gs)
      (HNl' : List.length Ns' = im_nn Mk) (HXl : List.length X = im_nn Mk)
      (Hvl : List.length vs = List.length gs) (HAl : List.length As = List.length gs)
      (Hb : tele_rel (nr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) X X)
      (Hv : tele_rel (ar k X c) (cargs_nonrec gs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs))
      (Hnp : glu_nparams k Mk NEl Δ' Us' Ns' X)
      (HAs : forall j N A, List.nth_error As j = Some N ->
          List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) As) j = Some A -> Δ' ⊢ N : A)
      (Harg : forall gs1 r0 A0 gs2 N A v, gs = gs1 ++ ca_arg r0 A0 :: gs2 ->
          List.nth_error As (List.length gs1) = Some N ->
          List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) As) (List.length gs1) = Some A ->
          List.nth_error vs (List.length gs1) = Some v ->
          Δ' ⊢ N : A ® v ∈ AEl k X c (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1))
                             (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs)))
      (Hrec : forall gs1 t gs2 N A v, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
          List.nth_error As (List.length gs1) = Some N ->
          List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) As) (List.length gs1) = Some A ->
          List.nth_error vs (List.length gs1) = Some v ->
          glu_rec p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Δ' Us' (X ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs))
            (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) t A N v)
      (IH : forall gs1 t gs2 N A v, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
          List.nth_error As (List.length gs1) = Some N ->
          List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) As) (List.length gs1) = Some A ->
          List.nth_error vs (List.length gs1) = Some v ->
          rec_glu_at_type k Δ' Us' (X ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs))
            (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) t A N v).
    Hypotheses (HΔ' : ⊢ Δ') (HUs : glu_args Δ' (ind_uparams D) Id nil Us' ups)
      (Hia : con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nr) nr ar dr k ups ups
               X X (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) gs vs vs).

    Lemma at_con_lens : List.length Us' = ind_nu D /\ List.length X = im_nn Mk.
    Proof.
      destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ HUs) as [LU _].
      split; [ exact LU | exact HXl ].
    Qed.

    Lemma at_con_params : glu_args Δ' (im_params D Mk) Id nil (Us' ++ Ns') (ups ++ X).
    Proof.
      unfold im_params; apply glu_args_app; [ exact (decl_closed_ass _ Hc) | exact (proj1 at_con_lens) | rewrite Hu; reflexivity |].
      split; [ exact HUs | exact (glu_args_of_nparams D ups u NP NEl AP AEl DP DEl Hf k Mk Δ' Us' Ns' X HMk Hnp Hb) ].
    Qed.

    Lemma at_con_HΨ : ⊨ cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_params D Mk.
    Proof.
      pose proof (valid_group_cargs_sem_all p D Hvg Hcv k Mk c gs HMk Hcon gs nil (eq_sym (List.app_nil_r gs))) as [H _]; exact H.
    Qed.

The instance of the telescope's type at a position.
    Lemma at_con_inst : forall n g, List.nth_error gs n = Some g ->
        exists κ A T, List.nth_error (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs)) n = Some (ce_ass κ A) /\
          List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) As) n = Some T /\
          T = A[sb_of_list (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) (List.firstn n As)].
    Proof.
      intros n g Hg.
      assert (Hn : n < List.length gs) by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence).
      destruct (nth_error_lt_some' (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) As) n) as [T HT].
      { rewrite length_tele_insts by apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass; rewrite length_cargs_ctx; lia. }
      destruct (tele_insts_nth _ _ _ _ _ HT) as (κ & A & HA & ET).
      exists κ, A, T; auto.
    Qed.

    Lemma at_con_args_prefix : forall n, n <= List.length gs ->
        glu_args Δ' (cargs_ctx p D Mk (List.firstn n gs)) (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns'))
          (env_tele nil (List.rev (im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X)) (List.firstn n As) (List.firstn n vs).
    Proof.
      destruct at_con_lens as [LU LX].
      assert (Hlp : List.length (ups ++ X) = List.length (List.rev (im_params D Mk)))
        by (rewrite List.length_rev, List.length_app, length_im_params; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia).
      induction n as [| n IHn]; intros Hn; [ cbn; apply glu_args_nil |].
      destruct (nth_error_lt_some' gs n ltac:(lia)) as [g Hg].
      destruct (nth_error_lt_some' As n ltac:(lia)) as [N HN].
      destruct (nth_error_lt_some' vs n ltac:(lia)) as [v Hvn].
      pose proof (IHn ltac:(lia)) as Hpre_g.
      assert (Heq : gs = List.firstn n gs ++ g :: List.skipn (S n) gs)
        by (rewrite <- (skipn_nth_cons' _ _ _ Hg), List.firstn_skipn; reflexivity).
      assert (Lgs1 : List.length (List.firstn n gs) = n) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
      assert (LAs1 : List.length (List.firstn n As) = n) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
      assert (Lvs1 : List.length (List.firstn n vs) = n) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
      set (gs1 := List.firstn n gs) in *; set (gs2 := List.skipn (S n) gs) in *.
      set (fa := List.firstn n vs) in *.
      rewrite (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ Hg), (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ HN), (firstn_S_snoc _ _ _ Hvn); fold gs1 fa.
      rewrite cargs_ctx_snoc.
      apply glu_args_app; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | rewrite length_cargs_ctx; lia | rewrite length_cargs_ctx; lia |].
      split; [ exact Hpre_g |].
      destruct (at_con_inst n g Hg) as (κ & A & T & HA & HT & ET).
The closed telescope before the argument, related at itself.
      assert (HgPA : glu_args Δ' (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk) Id nil ((Us' ++ Ns') ++ List.firstn n As) ((ups ++ X) ++ fa)).
      { destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ at_con_params) as [LP' LB'].
        apply glu_args_app; [ exact (decl_closed_params_ass D k Mk Hc HMk) | exact LP' | exact LB' |].
        split; [ exact at_con_params | exact Hpre_g ]. }
      pose proof (glu_args_per_tele_args _ _ _ _ _ _ ltac:(apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass
                                                                                   | exact (decl_closed_params_ass D k Mk Hc HMk) ])
                    HgPA) as Hpg.
      rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Hpg.
The environment of the arguments before, over the parameters.
      assert (Eρ : env_tele (env_tele nil (List.rev (im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X)) (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1)) fa
                   = env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X ++ fa))
        by (rewrite List.rev_app_distr, List.app_assoc, env_tele_app by exact Hlp; reflexivity).
The parameters, a glued substitution.
      destruct (glu_rel_ctx_types_ctx _ (glu_ind_decl_params _ HG _ _ HMk)) as [SbP HSbP].
      assert (Hσ0 : Δ' ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns') ® env_tele nil (List.rev (im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X) ∈ SbP).
      { pose proof HSbP as HSbP'; rewrite <- (List.app_nil_r (im_params D Mk)) in HSbP'.
        eapply glu_sub_of_list with (C := im_params D Mk) (Γ0 := ⋅) (Sb0 := nil_glu_sub_pred);
          [ exact (decl_closed_params_ass D k Mk Hc HMk) | exact HSbP'
          | econstructor; [ reflexivity | eapply ctx_wf_gctx; exact HΔ' ]
          | cbn; apply wf_sub_nil'; exact HΔ' | exact at_con_params ]. }
      destruct g as [r0 A0 | t].
      -
A non-recursive argument.
        cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app].
        pose proof (cargs_rev_nth_arg p D Mk gs gs1 r0 A0 gs2 Heq) as HA0; rewrite Lgs1, HA in HA0; injection HA0 as -> ->.
        apply (proj2 (glu_args_snoc Δ' nil _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _)); split; [| apply glu_args_nil ].
        destruct (valid_group_arg_types p D Hvg Hcv k Mk c gs gs1 r0 A0 gs2 ups X fa HMk Hcon Heq Hu LX ltac:(lia) Hpg)
          as (i0 & R0 & a & a' & Ea & Ea' & HR0).
        rewrite <- Lgs1 in HN, HT, Hvn.
        rewrite ET in HT.
        pose proof (Harg gs1 r0 A0 gs2 N _ v Heq HN HT Hvn) as HNg.
        set (K := List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) in *.
        assert (HBk : List.nth_error (cargs_nonrec gs) K = Some A0)
          by (unfold K; rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.nth_error_app2, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
