An argument, glued at the type its entry stores in the components before it (cargs_entry_type, as cargs_entries stores it): a non-recursive one at its family's value (ind_fams_glu), a recursive one at its shape's type's value, by the induction (rec_glu_at_type).
    Lemma at_con_arg_stored : forall gs1 g gs2 N T v, gs = gs1 ++ g :: gs2 ->
        List.nth_error As (List.length gs1) = Some N ->
        List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) As) (List.length gs1) = Some T ->
        List.nth_error vs (List.length gs1) = Some v ->
        exists (i : nat) a P El, glu_stored_at Δ' T N v
          (cargs_entry_type p ups (components_env D ups (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1)
                                     (X ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs))) g) i a P El.
    Proof.
      intros gs1 g gs2 N T v Heq HN HT Hvn.
      destruct at_con_lens as [LU LX].
      set (fa := List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs) in *.
      assert (Hlfa : List.length fa = List.length gs1) by (unfold fa; rewrite List.length_firstn; rewrite Heq, List.length_app in Hvl; cbn in Hvl; lia).
      set (K := List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)).
      set (nv := nonrec_arg_vals gs1 fa).
      destruct g as [r0 A0 | t].
      -
A non-recursive argument: at its family's value.
        pose proof (Harg gs1 r0 A0 gs2 N T v Heq HN HT Hvn) as HNg; fold fa nv K in HNg.
        assert (HBk : List.nth_error (cargs_nonrec gs) K = Some A0)
          by (unfold K; rewrite Heq, cargs_nonrec_app, List.nth_error_app2, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
        assert (Hpk : tele_prefix_rel (ar k X c) K nv nv)
          by (unfold nv, fa, K; eapply nonrec_prefix_pre; [ exact Hv | exact Hvl | exact Heq ]).
        destruct (ind_fams_glu_arg_eval _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hb Hcon HBk Hpk) as [a' Ea'].
        pose proof (ind_fams_glu_arg_glu _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hf _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hb Hcon HBk Hpk Ea') as Hgb.
        assert (Hlnv : List.length (X ++ nv) <= List.length (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1))
          by (rewrite !List.length_app, List.length_rev, length_im_nparams, length_cargs_nonrec_tele;
              unfold nv; rewrite length_nonrec_arg_vals by lia; unfold K; lia).
        assert (Ea0 : ⟦ A0 ⟧ components_env D ups (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) (X ++ nv) ↘ a').
        { pose proof (f_equal cargs_nonrec_tele Heq) as Et; rewrite cargs_nonrec_tele_app in Et.
          unfold components_env in Ea' |- *.
          rewrite Et, List.app_assoc, env_tele_app_long in Ea' by exact Hlnv; exact Ea'. }
        set (n := large_level u).
        assert (Hun : universe_index_le u (ul n)) by (apply universe_index_le_ul_max; unfold n; lia).
        destruct (glu_univ_elem_cumu_ge_universe_index Hun Hgb) as (Pn & Eln & Hgn).
        exists n, a', Pn, Eln; constructor; [ apply eval_entry_type_closure; exact Ea0 | exact Hgn |].
        eapply glu_univ_elem_exp_cumu_ge_universe_index; [ exact Hun | exact Hgb | exact Hgn | exact HNg ].
      -
A recursive argument: at its shape's type's value.
        set (nn := List.length gs1) in *.
        assert (Hg : List.nth_error gs nn = Some (ca_rec t))
          by (unfold nn; rewrite Heq, List.nth_error_app2, Nat.sub_diag by lia; reflexivity).
        assert (Hnle : nn <= List.length gs) by (rewrite Heq, List.length_app; cbn; unfold nn; lia).
        pose proof (at_con_args_prefix nn Hnle) as Hpre_g.
        assert (Egs1 : List.firstn nn gs = gs1) by (unfold nn; rewrite Heq, firstn_app_exact by reflexivity; reflexivity).
        rewrite Egs1 in Hpre_g; fold fa in Hpre_g.
        assert (Hlp : List.length (ups ++ X) = List.length (List.rev (im_params D Mk)))
          by (rewrite List.length_rev, List.length_app, length_im_params; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia).
        destruct (at_con_inst nn _ Hg) as (κ & A & T' & HA & HT' & ET).
        rewrite HT in HT'; injection HT' as <-.
        pose proof (cargs_rev_nth_rec p D Mk gs gs1 t gs2 Heq) as HA0; fold nn in HA0; rewrite HA in HA0; injection HA0 as -> ->.
        assert (Eρ : env_tele (env_tele nil (List.rev (im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X)) (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1)) fa
                     = env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X ++ fa))
          by (rewrite List.rev_app_distr, List.app_assoc, env_tele_app by exact Hlp; reflexivity).
        destruct (glu_rel_ctx_types_ctx _ (glu_ind_decl_params _ HG _ _ HMk)) as [SbP HSbP].
        assert (Hσ0 : Δ' ⊢ˢ sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns') ® env_tele nil (List.rev (im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X) ∈ SbP).
        { pose proof HSbP as HSbP'; rewrite <- (List.app_nil_r (im_params D Mk)) in HSbP'.
          eapply glu_sub_of_list with (C := im_params D Mk) (Γ0 := ⋅) (Sb0 := nil_glu_sub_pred);
            [ exact (decl_closed_params_ass D k Mk Hc HMk) | exact HSbP'
            | econstructor; [ reflexivity | eapply ctx_wf_gctx; exact HΔ' ]
            | cbn; apply wf_sub_nil'; exact HΔ' | exact at_con_params ]. }
        assert (HgPA : glu_args Δ' (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk) Id nil ((Us' ++ Ns') ++ List.firstn nn As) ((ups ++ X) ++ fa)).
        { destruct (glu_args_length _ _ _ _ _ _ at_con_params) as [LP' LB'].
          apply glu_args_app; [ exact (decl_closed_params_ass D k Mk Hc HMk) | exact LP' | exact LB' |].
          split; [ exact at_con_params | exact Hpre_g ]. }
        pose proof (glu_args_per_tele_args _ _ _ _ _ _ ltac:(apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass
                                                                                     | exact (decl_closed_params_ass D k Mk Hc HMk) ])
                      HgPA) as Hpg.
        rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Hpg.
        assert (Hpk : tele_prefix_rel (ar k X c) K nv nv)
          by (unfold nv, fa, K; eapply nonrec_prefix_pre; [ exact Hv | exact Hvl | exact Heq ]).
        assert (Heq1 : gs = (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) ++ gs2) by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact Heq).
        destruct (cargs_suffix_glu p D Mk gs (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: nil) gs2 Heq1 (HΨall _ _ _ _ _ _ HPD HMk Hcon)) as [SbT HSbT].
        rewrite cargs_ctx_snoc in HSbT; cbn [cargs_ctx_aux List.app] in HSbT.
        destruct (glu_ctx_env_suffix (ce_ass ak_relevant (ptyp_ty p D (im_nn Mk) (cargs_pat gs1) t) :: nil) _ _
                    (List.Forall_cons _ (ex_intro _ _ (ex_intro _ _ eq_refl)) (List.Forall_nil _)) HSbT) as [Sb1 HSb1].
        destruct (glu_ctx_env_cons_clean_inversion HSb1 HSbT) as (iT & HAty & HTT & _).
        assert (Hσ1 : Δ' ⊢ˢ sb_of_list (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) (List.firstn nn As)
                        ® env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X ++ fa) ∈ Sb1).
        { rewrite <- Eρ; exact (glu_sub_of_list _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (cargs_ctx_aux_ass _ _ _ _ _) HSb1 HSbP Hσ0 Hpre_g). }
        assert (HTiT : Δ' ⊢ T : Typeω@iT).
        { pose proof (glu_ctx_env_sub_escape HSb1 _ _ _ Hσ1) as Hσt.
          cbn [abs_kind_sort] in HAty; rewrite ET.
          replace (Typeω@iT : exp) with (Typeω@iT)[sb_of_list (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) (List.firstn nn As)] by reflexivity.
          mauto 3. }
        destruct (HTT _ _ _ Hσ1) as [acl PT ElT Eacl HgT HTP].
        destruct (glu_univ_elem_per_univ _ _ _ _ HgT) as [Rcl HRcl].
        destruct (valid_group_cargs_sem_all p D Hvg Hcv k Mk c gs HMk Hcon gs1 (ca_rec t :: gs2) Heq) as [HW0 _].
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HW0) as [R0 HR0].
        assert (HlC : List.length (ups ++ X ++ fa) = List.length (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk))
          by (rewrite !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params, LX; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia).
        assert (Hpre_env : forall R, EF cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ≈ cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk
                                        ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ R ->
                             R (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X ++ fa))
                               (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X ++ fa)))
          by (intros R HR; exact (tele_args_env_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ HR HW0 HlC Hpg)).
        pose proof (fun Mj qc kc Is vm Dq cups cs bs0 bs0' =>
                      ViewReadback.view_end_type VP HVP p D HPD ups Hgu Hu (ptyp_mem t) Mj qc kc Is vm Dq cups cs bs0 bs0') as Hend.
        assert (Hn0 : 0 + List.length (ptyp_doms t) = List.length (ptyp_doms t)) by lia.
        assert (Hgy0 : per_tele_args (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn 0 (ptyp_doms t))))
                         (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X ++ fa))
                         (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X ++ fa)) nil nil)
          by constructor.
        assert (Eacl0 : ⟦ ptyp_ty p D (im_nn Mk) (List.repeat false 0 ++ cargs_pat gs1) (ptyp_skip 0 t) ⟧
                          env_tele (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs1 ++ im_params D Mk)) (ups ++ X ++ fa))
                            (List.rev (shape_domains_ctx (cargs_pat gs1) (List.firstn 0 (ptyp_doms t)))) nil ↘ acl)
          by exact Eacl.
        destruct (shape_type_link p D Hvg Hcv k Mk c gs HMk Hcon at_con_HΨ gs1 t gs2 Heq ups X fa Hu LX Hlfa Hgu Hb Hpk Hpre_env Hend
                    (List.length (ptyp_doms t)) 0 nil acl iT Rcl Hn0 (tele_prefix_rel_nil _) Hgy0 Eacl0 HRcl)
          as (bsh & Ebsh & Hab).
        pose proof (shape_char p D Hvg Hcv k Mk c gs HMk Hcon at_con_HΨ gs1 t gs2 Heq ups X fa Hu LX Hlfa Hgu Hb Hpk Hpre_env
                      (Completeness.Inductives.ViewArgs.view_end_rel_all VP p D HVP HPD ups ups Hgu Hu (ptyp_mem t))
                      (Completeness.Inductives.ViewArgs.rview_end_rel_all VP p D HVP HPD ups ups Hgu Hu (ptyp_mem t))
                      (List.length (ptyp_doms t)) 0 nil acl iT Rcl Hn0 (tele_prefix_rel_nil _) Hgy0 Eacl0 HRcl) as ERcl.
        destruct (Completeness.Inductives.CargsRel.con_args_rel_at _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hia gs1 t gs2 Heq)
          as (x & x' & Hx & Hx' & Hra).
        fold nn in Hx, Hx'; rewrite Hvn in Hx; injection Hx as <-; rewrite Hvn in Hx'; injection Hx' as <-.
        assert (HRv : Rcl v v).
        { apply ERcl; cbn [ptyp_skip List.firstn]; rewrite !List.app_nil_r; unfold nv, fa, nn; exact Hra. }
        set (m := Nat.max iT nb).
        destruct Hab as [Rab HRab].
        destruct (per_univ_trans' _ _ _ _ _ (per_univ_sym' _ _ _ (ex_intro _ Rab HRab)) (ex_intro _ Rab HRab)) as [Rbb HRbb].
        pose proof (per_univ_elem_cumu_ge iT m _ _ _ ltac:(unfold m; lia) HRbb) as HRbbm.
        destruct (per_univ_glu_univ_elem m bsh (ex_intro _ Rbb HRbbm)) as (Ps & Els & Hgs).
        assert (HRvs : forall R', DF bsh ≈ bsh ∈ per_univ_elem m ↘ R' -> R' v v).
        { intros R' HR'.
          apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRbbm HR').
          apply (per_univ_elem_left_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRab HRbb).
          apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRcl HRab); exact HRv. }
        assert (HUl0 : List.length (Us' ++ Ns') = im_np D Mk) by (rewrite List.length_app, LU, HNl'; unfold im_np; lia).
        pose proof (cargs_rec_type_shape p D Mk gs gs1 t gs2 (Us' ++ Ns') As _ Heq Hc HUl0 HT) as HTeq.
        rewrite firstn_app_exact in HTeq by exact LU.
        assert (Hc0 : ind_con Mk c = Some (gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2)) by (rewrite <- Heq; exact Hcon).
        assert (Hpre_eq : X ++ nv = X ++ nv ++ nil) by (rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity).
        assert (HTs0 : List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1
                       = List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn 0 (shape_doms_tele t))
          by (cbn [List.firstn]; rewrite List.app_nil_r; reflexivity).
        pose proof Hpk as Hlk; rewrite tele_prefix_rel_iff in Hlk; destruct Hlk as (Hlk & _ & _).
        assert (Ebsh0 : ⟦shty t of p ups ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮
                          components_env D ups (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) (X ++ nv) ↘ bsh).
        { rewrite HTs0, Hpre_eq, (shape_comps_env_full Mk gs1 t 0 X nv nil LX Hlk ltac:(cbn; lia) ltac:(lia)).
          cbn [ptyp_skip] in Ebsh; exact Ebsh. }
        pose proof (components_of_uparams p D HG Hc Hdt Hsu Hass ups bu u NP NEl AP AEl DP DEl Hu Hbu Hule Hf Hself
                      Δ' Us' HΔ' HUs) as Hcomps.
        assert (Hargs : forall hs1 rB B hs2 N0 T0 v0, gs1 = hs1 ++ ca_arg rB B :: hs2 -> List.nth_error As (List.length hs1) = Some N0 ->
                  List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us' ++ Ns')) As) (List.length hs1) = Some T0 ->
                  List.nth_error fa (List.length hs1) = Some v0 ->
                  Δ' ⊢ N0 : T0 ® v0 ∈ AEl k X c (List.length (cargs_nonrec hs1))
                                        (nonrec_arg_vals hs1 (List.firstn (List.length hs1) fa))).
        { intros * Ehs HN0 HT0 Hv0.
          assert (Hlt : List.length hs1 < List.length gs1) by (rewrite Ehs, List.length_app; cbn; lia).
          unfold fa in Hv0 |- *; rewrite nth_error_firstn_lt in Hv0 by exact Hlt.
          rewrite List.firstn_firstn, Nat.min_l by lia.
          exact (Harg hs1 rB B (hs2 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2) N0 T0 v0
                   ltac:(rewrite Heq, Ehs, <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity) HN0 HT0 Hv0). }
        pose proof (ind_glu_components_recs _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hcomps k Mk c gs gs1 t gs2 Ns' X As fa _ HMk Hcon Heq Hnp Hb
                      Hlfa HT Hargs Hpk) as Hst.
        assert (HTty : Δ' ⊢ T : Typeω@m) by (eapply lift_exp_ge; [| exact HTiT ]; unfold m; lia).
        pose proof (rec_typ_glu t k Δ' Us' (X ++ nv) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) T Hst
                      Mk X c gs1 t gs2 nv 0 nil _ bsh m m Ps Els HMk Hc0 Hpre_eq HTs0 Hb Hpk eq_refl
                      (tele_prefix_rel_nil _) HUs HTeq HTty Ebsh0 (le_n _) ltac:(unfold m; lia) Hgs) as HTs.
        pose proof (IH gs1 t gs2 N _ v Heq HN HT Hvn) as HI0; fold fa nv in HI0.
        pose proof (HI0 Mk X c gs1 t gs2 nv 0 nil _ bsh m Ps Els HMk Hc0 Hpre_eq HTs0 Hb Hpk eq_refl
                      (tele_prefix_rel_nil _) HUs HTeq Hst (HAs _ _ _ HN HT) Ebsh0 HRvs Hgs HTs) as HNs.
        exists m, bsh, Ps, Els; constructor; [ cbn [cargs_entry_type]; apply eval_entry_type_shape; exact Ebsh0 | exact Hgs | exact HNs ].
    Qed.

The type of the constructor's application at the parameters and arguments: the member's type at the parameters.
    Lemma at_con_ty : im_is_rview Mk = false ->
        (ind_mty p D k (ind_uvars D (im_nn Mk) (List.length gs)) (vars_from (List.length gs) (im_nn Mk)))
          [sb_of_list Id ((Us' ++ Ns') ++ As)] = im_ty_at p k Mk Us' Ns'.
    Proof.
      intros Hrv; destruct at_con_lens as [LU _].
      destruct (im_head Mk) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh;
        [| | exfalso; exact (not_rview_record _ _ _ _ Hrv Hh) ].
      - rewrite (con_codomain_inst p D k Mk pm gs HMk Hh) by (rewrite !List.length_app; unfold im_np; lia).
        rewrite firstn_app_exact by (rewrite List.length_app; unfold im_np; lia).
        symmetry; exact (im_ty_at_decl p k Mk pm Us' Ns' Hh).
      - rewrite <- List.app_assoc, <- HAl.
        rewrite (view_ty_inst p D k Mk qc kc Is vm Id Us' Ns' As Hc HMk Hh LU HNl').
        unfold im_ty_at, im_ref, im_pre; rewrite Hh; reflexivity.
    Qed.

The constructor, glued at its type's gluing at any level: through con_base (declared) or con_view_base (view) at the value of the constructor's codomain, which is related to the type's value, and at the stored uniform parameters pre the type is at.
    Lemma elem_at_con : forall bs hd k' M', List.length bs = (im_unu D Mk + im_nn Mk)%nat ->
        List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs = X -> im_ref p k Mk = (hd, k') ->
        Δ' ⊢ M' ≈ apps (a_con p k c) (Us' ++ Ns' ++ As) : im_ty_at p k Mk Us' Ns' ->
        elem_glu_at_type k Δ' Us' Ns' M' (d_con hd k' c (bs ++ vs)).
    Proof.
      intros bs hd k' M' Hbl EX Href HMeq Mk0 ns hd0 k0 pre i P El HMk0 Hr _ _ _ Hns HGm Hglu HT.
      rewrite HMk in HMk0; injection HMk0 as <-.
      destruct (ViewReadback.mref_ref_len p D k Mk ups hd0 k0 pre Hl HMk Hu Hr) as [Href0 Lpre].
      rewrite Href in Href0; injection Href0 as <- <-.
      destruct at_con_lens as [LU LX].
      pose proof (decl_closed_params_ass D k Mk Hc HMk) as HassP.
      assert (HassC : all_assumptions (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_params D Mk))
        by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply cargs_ctx_aux_ass | exact HassP ]).
All the parameters and arguments, glued.
      pose proof (at_con_args_prefix (List.length gs) (le_n _)) as HgA.
      rewrite (List.firstn_all2 (n := List.length gs) gs), (List.firstn_all2 (n := List.length gs) As),
        (List.firstn_all2 (n := List.length gs) vs) in HgA by lia.
      assert (HgAll : glu_args Δ' (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_params D Mk) Id nil ((Us' ++ Ns') ++ As) ((ups ++ X) ++ vs)).
      { apply glu_args_app; [ exact HassP | rewrite length_im_params, List.length_app; unfold im_np; lia
                            | rewrite length_im_params, List.length_app; unfold im_np; lia |].
        split; [ exact at_con_params | exact HgA ]. }
      pose proof (glu_args_per_tele_args _ _ _ _ _ _ HassC HgAll) as Hpg.
      destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env at_con_HΨ) as [RΨ HRΨ].
      assert (HlΨ : List.length ((ups ++ X) ++ vs) = List.length (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_params D Mk))
        by (rewrite !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_params; unfold im_np, ind_nu in *; lia).
      pose proof (tele_args_env_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ HRΨ at_con_HΨ HlΨ Hpg) as HE.
The value of the constructor's codomain there.
      destruct (Completeness.Inductives.Con.mty_vars_valid_at p D Hvg Hcv k Mk (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) HMk at_con_HΨ) as [jb Hjb].
      rewrite length_cargs_ctx in Hjb.
      destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRΨ Hjb _ _ HE) as (b & b' & Eb & Eb' & [Rb HRb]).
      assert (b' = b) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
The environment, as the components after the uniform parameters.
      assert (EZ : env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_params D Mk)) ((ups ++ X) ++ vs)
                   = components_env D ups (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk)) (X ++ vs))
        by (unfold im_params; rewrite List.app_assoc, <- (List.app_assoc ups);
            apply Completeness.Inductives.Con.env_tele_closed_components; exact Hu).
      pose proof Eb as Ebc; rewrite EZ in Ebc.
      rewrite <- List.app_assoc in Eb.
The scrutinee's parameters, related to the stored ones.
      assert (Hns' : tele_rel (nr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) ns X).
      { pose proof (mref_rview_false _ _ _ HMk Hr) as Hrv.
        unfold grp_rel in HGm; inversion HGm; subst;
          match goal with H1 : ind_member D k = Some ?M1 |- _ => rewrite HMk in H1; injection H1 as <- end;
          [| match goal with H2 : im_head Mk = mh_record _ _ _ |- _ => exfalso; exact (not_rview_record _ _ _ _ Hrv H2) end ].
        match goal with E : (?a ++ ?b = bs ++ vs)%list |- _ => apply app_split_eq in E; [| lia ]; destruct E as [-> ->] end.
        first [ assumption | rewrite <- EX; assumption ]. }
      
The type's value, related to the codomain's.
      assert (HZ : ⊨ (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk) ++ ind_uparams D) by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact at_con_HΨ).
      assert (HRZ : EF (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk) ++ ind_uparams D
                      ≈ (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk) ++ ind_uparams D ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΨ)
        by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; exact HRΨ).
      pose proof HE as HE0; rewrite EZ in HE0.
      assert (HlZ : List.length (X ++ vs) = List.length (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_nparams Mk))
        by (rewrite !List.length_app, length_cargs_ctx, length_im_nparams; lia).
      destruct (mty_val_rel k Mk hd k' pre _ RΨ X vs (List.length gs) b ns HMk Hr HZ HRZ HlZ LX Hvl HE0 Ebc Hns')
        as (i0 & R0 & Hab).
      pose proof (per_univ_elem_cumu_universe_index _ _ _ _ Hab (ul (large_level i0)) ltac:(apply universe_index_le_ul_max; lia)) as Hab'.
The constructor's value, related to the scrutinee.
      destruct (glu_univ_elem_per_univ _ _ _ _ Hglu) as [R HR].
      pose proof (mref_rel k Mk hd k' pre ns i R HMk Hr HR) as ER.
      assert (Ebs : bs ++ vs = List.firstn (im_unu D Mk) bs ++ (X ++ vs))
        by (rewrite <- EX, List.app_assoc, List.firstn_skipn; reflexivity).
      assert (Hwm : G k ups ups ns ns (d_con hd k' c (pre ++ X ++ vs)) (d_con hd k' c (bs ++ vs))).
      { rewrite Ebs in HGm |- *; unfold grp_rel in *.
        eapply Completeness.Inductives.Elim.ind_rel_con_prefix_l;
          [ exact HMk | | | exact HGm ]; rewrite ?List.length_firstn; lia. }
      assert (Hww : G k ups ups ns ns (d_con hd k' c (pre ++ X ++ vs)) (d_con hd k' c (pre ++ X ++ vs))).
      { rewrite Ebs in Hwm; unfold grp_rel in *.
        eapply Completeness.Inductives.Elim.ind_rel_con_prefix_r;
          [ exact HMk | | | exact Hwm ]; rewrite ?List.length_firstn; lia. }
      assert (HRw : Rb (d_con hd k' c (pre ++ X ++ vs)) (d_con hd k' c (pre ++ X ++ vs))).
      { apply (per_univ_elem_left_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hab HRb).
        apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HR Hab).
        apply ER; exact Hww. }
      
The constructor, glued at the codomain's value.
      destruct (sort_bound VP p D HVP HPD) as [n0 Hn0].
The codomain, glued at its instances (con_codomain_glued)
      destruct (con_codomain_glued VP p D HVP HPD HGall HSall k Mk c gs HMk Hcon) as [i1 HB1].
      set (ib := Nat.max (Nat.max (Nat.max jb nb) n0) i1).
      assert (HBv : glu_entry_valid_at ib ((cargs_ctx p D Mk gs ++ im_params D Mk) ++ ⋅) ak_relevant
                      (ind_mty p D k (ind_uvars D (im_nn Mk) (List.length gs)) (vars_from (List.length gs) (im_nn Mk)))).
      { apply (glu_entry_valid_at_cumu (i := i1)); [ unfold ib; lia |].
        rewrite List.app_nil_r; exact (glu_entry_valid_of_rel (glu_rel_exp_of_under_sub HB1)). }
      pose proof (per_univ_elem_cumu_ge jb ib _ _ _ ltac:(unfold ib; lia) HRb) as HRbL.
      destruct (per_univ_glu_univ_elem ib _ (ex_intro _ Rb HRbL)) as (Pb & Elb & Hgb).
      assert (Hper : forall R', DF b ≈ b ∈ per_univ_elem ib ↘ R' ->
                       R' (d_con hd k' c (pre ++ X ++ vs)) (d_con hd k' c (pre ++ X ++ vs))).
      { intros R' HR'; apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRbL HR'); exact HRw. }
      assert (Hcb : Δ' ⊢ apps (a_con p k c) ((Us' ++ Ns') ++ As)
                      : (ind_mty p D k (ind_uvars D (im_nn Mk) (List.length gs)) (vars_from (List.length gs) (im_nn Mk)))
                          [sb_of_list Id ((Us' ++ Ns') ++ As)]
                      ® d_con hd k' c (pre ++ X ++ vs) ∈ Elb).
      { destruct (im_head Mk) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh; [| | exfalso; exact (mref_not_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hr) ].
        - pose proof (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMk Hh Hr) as E; injection E as Ehd Ek Epre.
          assert (Hw : Completeness.Inductives.Con.con_value p D k Mk c ((ups ++ X) ++ vs) (d_con hd k' c (pre ++ X ++ vs))).
          { rewrite Ehd, Ek, Epre, List.app_assoc; exact (Completeness.Inductives.Con.con_value_decl p D k Mk c pm _ Hh). }
          eapply (con_base VP p D HVP HPD HG (Hviewsall _ _ HPD) HSall k Mk pm c gs HMk Hh Hcon);
            [ exact HΔ' | intros ρ0 b0 Eb0; exact (Hn0 _ _ Eb0 ib ltac:(unfold ib; lia)) | exact HgAll | exact Hw | exact Eb'
            | exact Hgb | exact Hper ].
        - destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMk Hh Hr) as (py & E & Epy); injection E as Ehd Ek Epre.
          destruct (decl_typed_view _ _ _ Hdt _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh) as (Dq & Mkc & Hq & HMkc & Hkd & _ & _ & Hvm & _).
          pose proof (valid_groups_containers VP HVP p D k Mk qc kc Is vm Dq HPD HMk Hh Hq) as HPq.
          pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HVP qc Dq HPq) as HgQ.
          assert (Hhd : exists pmc, im_head Mkc = mh_decl pmc).
          { pose proof (proj2 (decl_typed_order _ _ _ (valid_group_typed _ _ HgQ) _ _ HMkc) Hkd) as Hd0.
            unfold im_is_decl in Hd0; destruct (im_head Mkc); [ eauto | discriminate | discriminate ]. }
          destruct Hhd as [pmc Hhc].
          destruct (Completeness.Inductives.Con.view_con_container p D Hass Hdt k Mk qc kc Is vm Dq Mkc c gs HMk Hh Hq HMkc Hcon)
            as (gs' & Hcon' & Hcorr).
          assert (Hw : Completeness.Inductives.Con.con_value p D k Mk c ((ups ++ X) ++ vs) (d_con hd k' c (pre ++ X ++ vs))).
          { rewrite Ehd, Ek.
            replace (pre ++ X ++ vs) with (pre ++ List.skipn (ind_nu D) ((ups ++ X) ++ vs))
              by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc, skipn_app_exact by exact Hu; reflexivity).
            eapply Completeness.Inductives.Con.con_value_view; [ exact Hh | rewrite !List.length_app; lia |].
            rewrite <- List.app_assoc, firstn_app_exact by exact Hu; rewrite Epre; exact Epy. }
          eapply (con_view_base VP HVP HGall Hviewsall HSall p D HPD k Mk qc kc Is vm c gs HMk Hh Hcon (HΨall _ _ _ _ _ _ HPD HMk Hcon)
                    (fun Dq0 Mc gs0 Hq0 HMc Hc0 => HΨall _ _ _ _ _ _ (valid_groups_containers _ HVP _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HPD HMk Hh Hq0) HMc Hc0) Dq Mkc pmc gs' ib);
            [ exact Hq | exact HMkc | exact Hhc | exact Hvm | exact Hcon' | exact Hcorr | exact HΔ'
            | intros ρ0 b0 Eb0; eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact (Hnbq _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hq _ _ Eb0) | apply ul_mono; unfold ib; lia ]
            | exact HgAll | exact Hw | exact Eb' | exact Hgb | exact Hper | exact HBv ]. }
      rewrite (at_con_ty (mref_rview_false _ _ _ HMk Hr)) in Hcb.
At the type's gluing, then at the scrutinee's value and term.
      pose proof (glu_elem_conv ib i (large_level i0) _ _ _ _ _ _ Δ' _ _ _ _ Hgb Hglu
                    (per_univ_sym' _ _ _ (ex_intro _ R0 Hab')) HT Hcb) as Hc1.
At the element's own stored uniform parameters, which the gluing does not read (glu_ind_con_prefix).
      assert (Hlp : forall D0, ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack hd = Some D0 -> List.length pre = ind_nu D0).
      { intros D0 HD0; rewrite Lpre; unfold im_unu.
        destruct (im_head Mk) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh.

        - unfold im_ref in Href; rewrite Hh in Href; injection Href as <- _.

      assert (Hrel' : forall R', DF d_ind hd k' (pre ++ ns) ≈ d_ind hd k' (pre ++ ns) ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R' ->
                        R' (d_con hd k' c (List.firstn (im_unu D Mk) bs ++ X ++ vs))
                           (d_con hd k' c (List.firstn (im_unu D Mk) bs ++ X ++ vs))).

      pose proof (glu_ind_con_prefix i hd k' (pre ++ ns) P El Δ' _ _ c pre (List.firstn (im_unu D Mk) bs) (X ++ vs) Hglu Hlp
                    ltac:(rewrite List.length_firstn, Lpre; lia) Hrel' Hc1) as Hc2.

  End AtCon.

The Bridge

Every element glued in the group, and every recursive argument, is glued at its type's own gluing, by induction on the group's gluing.

Record Views

An element of a record view glued in the group is glued at the record type: its fields, glued at the view's constructor's telescope as a constructor's arguments are (at_con_args_prefix), are glued along the record's fields (rview_cargs_to_fields); so are the projections of their tuple (field-β), and the tuple is the element (rview_con_tuple).
  Lemma elem_at_record : forall k Mk qr Is fl c gs Us Ns As vs Γ M m,
      ind_member D k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_record qr Is fl -> im_cons Mk = (c, gs) :: nil ->
      List.length Us = ind_nu D -> List.length Ns = im_nn Mk -> List.length As = List.length gs ->
      ⟦projs fl of m ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ vs ->
      Γ ⊢ M ≈ apps_exp (a_con p k c) (Us ++ Ns ++ As) : im_ty_at p k Mk Us Ns ->
      tele_rel (ar k nil c) (cargs_nonrec gs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs) (nonrec_arg_vals gs vs) ->
      (forall j N A, List.nth_error As j = Some N ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us ++ Ns)) As) j = Some A -> Γ ⊢ N : A) ->
      (forall gs1 r0 A0 gs2 N A v, gs = gs1 ++ ca_arg r0 A0 :: gs2 ->
         List.nth_error As (List.length gs1) = Some N ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us ++ Ns)) As) (List.length gs1) = Some A ->
         List.nth_error vs (List.length gs1) = Some v ->
         Γ ⊢ N : A ® v ∈ AEl k nil c (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs))) ->
      (forall gs1 t gs2 N A v, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
         List.nth_error As (List.length gs1) = Some N ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us ++ Ns)) As) (List.length gs1) = Some A ->
         List.nth_error vs (List.length gs1) = Some v ->
         glu_rec p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Γ Us (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1)
           t A N v) ->
      (forall gs1 t gs2 N A v, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
         List.nth_error As (List.length gs1) = Some N ->
         List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us ++ Ns)) As) (List.length gs1) = Some A ->
         List.nth_error vs (List.length gs1) = Some v ->
         rec_glu_at_type k Γ Us (nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) t A N v) ->
      rview_glu_at_type k Γ Us Ns M m.
  Proof.
    intros k Mk qr Is fl c gs Us Ns As vs Γ M m HMk Hh Hcs HUl HNl HAl Hps HMeq Hv HAs Harg Hrec IH.
    intros Mk0 qr0 Is0 fl0 cups i P El HMk0 Hh0 Ecups HUs HM' HGm Hglu HT.
    rewrite HMk in HMk0; injection HMk0 as <-; rewrite Hh in Hh0; injection Hh0 as <- <- <-.
    pose proof (RviewEnds.rview_args_nn p D Hvg k Mk qr Is fl HMk Hh) as Hnn.
    destruct Ns as [| ? ?]; [| cbn in HNl; lia ].
    assert (HΓ : ⊢ Γ) by (gen_presups; assumption).
    pose proof (ind_con_single _ _ _ Hcs) as Hcon.
    destruct (valid_group_records _ _ Hvg _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh) as [R HR].
    pose proof (valid_rview_record_lookup _ _ HR) as HlR.
    pose proof (ctx_wf_gctx _ _ _ HΓ) as Hgc.
    pose proof (RviewEnds.rview_args_len p D Hvg k Mk qr Is fl R c gs HMk Hh HR Hcs) as Hlg.
    pose proof (RviewEnds.rview_args_names p D Hvg k Mk qr Is fl R HMk Hh HR) as Hfl.
    assert (Hvl : List.length vs = List.length gs)
      by (rewrite (eval_projs_length _ _ _ Hps), Hfl, List.length_map; lia).
The fields, glued at the view's constructor's telescope.
    unfold grp_rel in HGm.
    destruct (ind_rel_record_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HGm HMk Hh Hcs) as [ws ws' _ _ Hp Hp' _ Hca].
    pose proof (functional_eval_projs _ _ _ _ Hp Hps) as ->.
    pose proof (functional_eval_projs _ _ _ _ Hp' Hps) as ->.
    assert (Hb : tele_rel (nr k) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) nil nil)
      by (rewrite (RviewEnds.rview_args_nparams p D Hvg k Mk qr Is fl HMk Hh); split; reflexivity + exact I).
    assert (Hnp : glu_nparams k Mk NEl Γ Us nil nil)
      by (constructor; [ cbn; lia | cbn; lia | intros [] *; discriminate ]).
The view has no non-uniform parameters.
    pose proof (RviewEnds.rview_args_nparams p D Hvg k Mk qr Is fl HMk Hh) as Hnp0.
    assert (IH' : forall gs1 t gs2 N A v, gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
               List.nth_error As (List.length gs1) = Some N ->
               List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id (Us ++ nil)) As) (List.length gs1) = Some A ->
               List.nth_error vs (List.length gs1) = Some v ->
               rec_glu_at_type k Γ Us (nil ++ nonrec_arg_vals gs1 (List.firstn (List.length gs1) vs))
                 (List.rev (im_nparams Mk) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) t A N v)
      by (intros * H1 H2 H3 H4; rewrite Hnp0; exact (IH _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 H2 H3 H4)).
    assert (Hca' : con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nr) nr ar dr k ups ups nil nil (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) gs vs vs)

    pose proof (at_con_args_prefix k Mk c gs Us nil nil vs As Γ HMk Hcon ltac:(cbn; lia) ltac:(cbn; lia) Hvl HAl Hb Hv Hnp HAs
                  Harg IH' HΓ HUs Hca' (List.length gs) (le_n _)) as HgC.
    rewrite !List.firstn_all2 in HgC by lia.
    rewrite !List.app_nil_r, (RviewEnds.rview_args_params p D Hvg k Mk qr Is fl HMk Hh) in HgC.
Along the record's fields, at the view's instance: the record's field context is glued (record_fctx_glued).
    pose proof (HRall _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HPD HMk Hh HlR) as HGR.
    pose proof (glu_rel_ctx_types_ctx _ (Mctt.Core.Soundness.Records.Former.record_fctx_glued R HGR _ (le_n _))) as HΨr.
    set (Ns' := List.map (fun I => I[sb_of_list Id Us]) Is).
    pose proof (valid_rview_record_closed _ _ HR) as HcR.
    pose proof (rview_record_len p D Hvg k Mk qr Is fl R HMk Hh HR) as HIl.
    pose proof (rview_uparams_glu VP p D HVP HPD HG Hselfs k Mk qr Is fl R HMk Hh HR Γ Us ups cups HΓ HUs Ecups) as HNs'.
    pose proof (rview_cargs_to_fields p D Hvg Hcv k Mk qr Is fl R c gs HMk Hh HR Hcs ups cups Hgu Hu Ecups HΨr
                  Γ Us As vs HΓ HUs HNs' HgC) as HgF'.
The element is the tuple of the fields.
    destruct (decl_typed_uparams _ _ _ Hdt) as [_ HUa].
    assert (HAs' : forall j N A, List.nth_error As j = Some N ->
               List.nth_error (tele_insts (cargs_ctx p D Mk gs) (sb_of_list Id Us) As) j = Some A -> Γ ⊢ N : A)
      by (rewrite List.app_nil_r in HAs; exact HAs).
    pose proof (rview_con_tuple Γ p D k Mk qr Is fl c gs Us As Hl HMk Hh Hcs HΓ HUl (glu_args_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ HUa HUs) HAl HAs')
      as Hct.
    assert (Hpre : im_pre Mk Us = Ns') by (unfold im_pre; rewrite Hh; reflexivity).
    assert (HTy : im_ty_at p k Mk Us nil = apps_exp (a_record qr) Ns')
      by (unfold im_ty_at, im_pre; rewrite Hh, List.app_nil_r; reflexivity).
    rewrite Hpre, HTy in Hct.
    set (Tp := a_tuple (apps_exp (a_record qr) Ns') (List.combine fl As)) in *.
    assert (HTpt : Γ ⊢ Tp : apps_exp (a_record qr) Ns') by (gen_presups; eassumption).
    pose proof (glu_univ_elem_univ_lvl_gen _ _ _ _ Hglu ltac:(discriminate) _ _ HT) as HjT.
    cbn [domain_kind abs_kind_sort] in HjT; rewrite HTy in HjT.
    set (jT := large_level i) in HjT.
    pose proof (record_typed_former _ _ Γ _ _ (valid_rview_record_typed _ _ HR) HlR HΓ) as Hrt.

The value, related at the record's relation.
    pose proof (RviewEnds.rview_args_container_uparams_rel p D Hvg k Mk qr Is fl R HMk Hh HR ups cups Hgu Hu Ecups) as Hc0.
    destruct (vrr_type_rel qr R cups cups HR Hc0 ltac:(rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ecups); exact HIl)) as [i1 HR1].
    pose proof (proj2 (rview_rel k Mk qr Is fl cups i1 _ HMk Hh Ecups HR1 m m) HGm) as Hm.

  Theorem glu_at_type_all :
    (forall k Γ Us Ns M mv, ind_glu_elem p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Γ Us Ns M mv ->
       elem_glu_at_type k Γ Us Ns M mv /\ rview_glu_at_type k Γ Us Ns M mv) /\
    (forall k Γ Us pre Ts t A N v, glu_rec p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl k Γ Us pre Ts t A N v -> rec_glu_at_type k Γ Us pre Ts t A N v).
  Proof.
    apply (ind_glu_elem_mut_ind_all p D ups NEl AEl DP DEl
             (fun k Γ Us Ns M mv _ => elem_glu_at_type k Γ Us Ns M mv /\ rview_glu_at_type k Γ Us Ns M mv)
             (fun k Γ Us pre Ts t A N v _ => rec_glu_at_type k Γ Us pre Ts t A N v)).
    - intros k Mk hd k' c gs Us Ns bs vs As Γ M HMk Hrv Href Hcon HUl HNl Hbl Hvl HAl HMeq Hb Hv Hnp HAs Harg Hrec IH.
      split; [| intros Mk0 qr0 Is0 fl0 *; intros HMk0 Hh0; rewrite HMk in HMk0; injection HMk0 as <-;
                exfalso; exact (not_rview_record _ _ _ _ Hrv Hh0) ].
      intros Mk0 ns hd0 k0 pre i P El HMk0 Hr HUs HM' Hgn Hns HGm Hglu HT.
      assert (Hia : con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D ups nr) nr ar dr k ups ups
                      (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) (List.rev (im_nparams Mk)) gs vs vs).
      { unfold grp_rel in HGm; inversion HGm; subst;
          match goal with H1 : ind_member D k = Some ?M1 |- _ => rewrite HMk in H1; injection H1 as <- end;
          [| match goal with H2 : im_head Mk = mh_record _ _ _ |- _ => exfalso; exact (not_rview_record _ _ _ _ Hrv H2) end ].
        match goal with H1 : ind_con Mk c = Some ?g1 |- _ => rewrite Hcon in H1; injection H1 as <- end.
        repeat match goal with E : (?a ++ ?b = bs ++ vs)%list |- _ => apply app_split_eq in E; [| lia ]; destruct E as [-> ->] end.
        assumption. }
      assert (HΓ : ⊢ Γ) by (gen_presups; assumption).
      exact (elem_at_con k Mk c gs Us Ns (List.skipn (im_unu D Mk) bs) vs As Γ HMk Hcon HNl
               ltac:(rewrite List.length_skipn; lia) Hvl HAl Hb Hv Hnp HAs Harg Hrec IH HΓ HUs Hia
               bs hd k' M Hbl eq_refl Href HMeq Mk0 ns hd0 k0 pre i P El HMk0 Hr HUs HM' Hgn Hns HGm Hglu HT).
    - intros k Mk hd k' m Γ M Us Ns as' HMk Hrv Href Hm Hrb Hnr Hnp.
      split; [ exact (elem_at_neut k Mk hd k' m Γ Us Ns M as' HMk Hrv Href Hm Hrb Hnr Hnp) |].
      intros Mk0 qr0 Is0 fl0 *; intros HMk0 Hh0; rewrite HMk in HMk0; injection HMk0 as <-.
      exfalso; exact (not_rview_record _ _ _ _ Hrv Hh0).
    - intros * HMk Hh Hcs HUl HNl HAl Hps HMeq Hv HAs Harg Hrec IH.
      split; [ intros Mk0 *; intros HMk0 Hr; rewrite HMk in HMk0; injection HMk0 as <-;
               exfalso; exact (mref_not_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hr) |].
      exact (elem_at_record _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hcs HUl HNl HAl Hps HMeq Hv HAs Harg Hrec IH).
    - intros j Mj Ps Ts pre A Us Γ N v k HMj Hs1 _ IH.
      exact (rec_at_self j Mj Ps Ts pre A Us Γ N v k HMj Hs1 IH).
    - intros A Γ k pre Ts B v Us t N Hq1 Hq2 Hq3 IH.
      exact (rec_at_pi A Γ k pre Ts B v Us t N Hq1 Hq2 Hq3 IH).
  Qed.

End AtType.

A Level Above the Containers' Sorts

A group of a valid family has finitely many views, each of a valid container, whose sort is bounded (sort_bound): a level above all of them and a given index, as AtType's nb needs.
Lemma views_sort_bound : forall VP p D, valid_groups VP -> VP p D ->
    forall l, (forall Mj, In Mj l -> exists j, ind_member D j = Some Mj) ->
    exists n, forall Mj qc kc Is vm Dq, In Mj l -> im_head Mj = mh_view qc kc Is vm -> ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some Dq ->
      forall ρ bq, ⟦ ind_sort Dq ⟧ ρ ↘ bq -> universe_index_le (Completeness.Inductives.Decl.univ_idx bq) (ul n).
Proof.
  intros VP p D HVP HPD; induction l as [| M l IH]; intros Hin.
  - exists 0; intros * [].
  - destruct (IH (fun Mj H => Hin Mj (or_intror H))) as [n Hn].
    destruct (im_head M) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh.
    + exists n; intros * [<- | H] Hh' Hq; [ rewrite Hh in Hh'; discriminate | exact (Hn _ _ _ _ _ _ H Hh' Hq) ].
    + destruct (Hin M (or_introl eq_refl)) as [j Hj].
      destruct (decl_typed_view _ _ _ (valid_group_typed _ _ (valid_groups_valid VP HVP p D HPD)) _ _ _ _ _ _ Hj Hh) as (Dq0 & _ & Hq0 & _).
      destruct (sort_bound VP qc Dq0 HVP (valid_groups_containers VP HVP p D j M qc kc Is vm Dq0 HPD Hj Hh Hq0)) as [m Hm].
      exists (Nat.max n m); intros * [<- | H] Hh' Hq ρ bq Eb.
      * rewrite Hh in Hh'; injection Hh' as <- <- <- <-; rewrite Hq0 in Hq; injection Hq as <-.
        exact (Hm _ _ Eb (Nat.max n m) ltac:(lia)).
      * eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact (Hn _ _ _ _ _ _ H Hh' Hq _ _ Eb) | apply universe_index_le_ul_max; cbn; lia ].
    + exists n; intros * [<- | H] Hh' Hq; [ rewrite Hh in Hh'; discriminate | exact (Hn _ _ _ _ _ _ H Hh' Hq) ].
Qed.

Likewise, the sorts of the records of the record views.
Lemma rviews_sort_bound : forall VP p D, valid_groups VP -> VP p D ->
    forall l, (forall Mj, In Mj l -> exists j, ind_member D j = Some Mj) ->
    exists n, forall Mj qr Is fl R, In Mj l -> im_head Mj = mh_record qr Is fl -> record_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qr = Some R ->
      forall ρ b, ⟦ record_sort R ⟧ ρ ↘ b -> universe_index_le (Completeness.Inductives.Decl.univ_idx b) (ul n).
Proof.
  intros VP p D HVP HPD; induction l as [| M l IH]; intros Hin.
  - exists 0; intros * [].
  - destruct (IH (fun Mj H => Hin Mj (or_intror H))) as [n Hn].
    destruct (im_head M) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Is fl] eqn:Hh;
      [ exists n; intros * [<- | H] Hh' Hq; [ rewrite Hh in Hh'; discriminate | exact (Hn _ _ _ _ _ H Hh' Hq) ] .. |].
    destruct (Hin M (or_introl eq_refl)) as [j Hj].
    destruct (valid_group_records _ _ (valid_groups_valid VP HVP p D HPD) _ _ _ _ _ Hj Hh) as [R0 HR0].
    pose proof (record_typed_sort_univ _ _ _ (valid_rview_record_typed _ _ HR0)) as Hsu.
    assert (Hm : exists m, forall ρ b, ⟦ record_sort R0 ⟧ ρ ↘ b -> forall i, m <= i ->
                   universe_index_le (Completeness.Inductives.Decl.univ_idx b) (ul i)).
    { destruct Hsu as [[i0 Heq] | [t Heq]]; rewrite Heq; [ exists i0 | exists 0 ]; intros * Hb i Hi;
        inversion Hb; subst; cbn; [ lia | exact I ]. }
    destruct Hm as [m Hm].
    exists (Nat.max n m); intros * [<- | H] Hh' Hq ρ b Eb.
    + rewrite Hh in Hh'; injection Hh' as <- <- <-.
      rewrite (valid_rview_record_lookup _ _ HR0) in Hq; injection Hq as <-.
      exact (Hm _ _ Eb (Nat.max n m) ltac:(lia)).
    + eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact (Hn _ _ _ _ _ H Hh' Hq _ _ Eb) | apply universe_index_le_ul_max; cbn; lia ].
Qed.

A common bound of finitely many bounds, each closed upward.
Lemma list_level_bound : forall {A : Type} (Q : A -> nat -> Prop), (forall a i i', Q a i -> i <= i' -> Q a i') ->
    forall l, (forall a, In a l -> exists i, Q a i) -> exists n, forall a, In a l -> Q a n.
Proof.
  intros A Q HQ; induction l as [| a l IH]; intros H; [ exists 0; intros ? [] |].
  destruct (H a (or_introl eq_refl)) as [i Hi]; destruct (IH (fun a' Ha' => H a' (or_intror Ha'))) as [n Hn].
  exists (Nat.max i n); intros a' [<- | Ha']; [ apply (HQ _ i); [ exact Hi | lia ] | apply (HQ _ n); [ exact (Hn _ Ha') | lia ] ].
Qed.

The domains of the shapes of a valid group are typed, in their contexts, at one level.
Lemma doms_level_bound : forall VP p D, valid_groups VP -> VP p D ->
    exists n, forall k Mk c gs gs1 t gs2 Bs1 B Bs2, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
      gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> ptyp_doms t = Bs1 ++ B :: Bs2 ->
      doms_ctx Bs1 ++ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ⊢ B : Typeω@n.
Proof.
  intros VP p D HVP HPD.
  pose proof (valid_group_typed _ _ (valid_groups_valid VP HVP p D HPD)) as Hdt.

               forall Bs1 B Bs2, ptyp_doms t = Bs1 ++ B :: Bs2 -> doms_ctx Bs1 ++ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ⊢ B : Typeω@n).
  assert (Mono : forall Mk gs1 t i i', Qd Mk gs1 t i -> i <= i' -> Qd Mk gs1 t i')
    by (intros * H Hi; unfold Qd in *; intros * E; exact (lift_exp_ge _ _ _ _ _ _ Hi (H _ _ _ E))).

A level for AtType's nb: above u, the sorts of the views' containers and those of the record views' records, and the domains of the group's shapes.
Record level_bound (p : qname) (D : ind_decl) (u : universe_index) (nb : nat) : Prop := mk_level_bound
  {
Above u
    level_bound_clause : universe_index_le u (ul nb)
    
Above the sorts of the views' containers
  ; level_bound_views : forall j Mj qc kc Is vm Dq, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_head Mj = mh_view qc kc Is vm ->
      ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some Dq -> forall ρ bq, ⟦ ind_sort Dq ⟧ ρ ↘ bq ->
      universe_index_le (Completeness.Inductives.Decl.univ_idx bq) (ul nb)
    
Above the sorts of the record views' records
  ; level_bound_records : forall j Mj qr Is fl R, ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_head Mj = mh_record qr Is fl ->
      record_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qr = Some R -> forall ρ b, ⟦ record_sort R ⟧ ρ ↘ b ->
      universe_index_le (Completeness.Inductives.Decl.univ_idx b) (ul nb)
    
Above the levels the domains of the shapes are typed at, in their contexts
  ; level_bound_doms : forall k Mk c gs gs1 t gs2 Bs1 B Bs2, ind_member D k = Some Mk -> ind_con Mk c = Some gs ->
      gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 -> ptyp_doms t = Bs1 ++ B :: Bs2 ->
      doms_ctx Bs1 ++ cargs_nonrec_ctx gs1 ++ im_params D Mk ⊢ B : Typeω@nb }.

Lemma nb_exists : forall VP p D, valid_groups VP -> VP p D -> forall u : universe_index, exists nb : nat, level_bound p D u nb.
Proof.
  intros VP p D HVP HPD u.
  destruct (views_sort_bound VP p D HVP HPD (ind_members D) (fun Mj H => List.In_nth_error _ _ H)) as [n Hn].
  destruct (rviews_sort_bound VP p D HVP HPD (ind_members D) (fun Mj H => List.In_nth_error _ _ H)) as [m Hm].
  destruct (doms_level_bound VP p D HVP HPD) as [d Hd].
  exists (Nat.max (Nat.max (Nat.max n m) (large_level u)) d); constructor; [ apply universe_index_le_ul_max; lia | | |].
  - intros * HMj Hh Hq ρ bq Eb.
    eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact (Hn _ _ _ _ _ _ (List.nth_error_In _ _ HMj) Hh Hq _ _ Eb) | apply universe_index_le_ul_max; cbn; lia ].
  - intros * HMj Hh Hq ρ b Eb.
    eapply universe_index_le_trans; [ exact (Hm _ _ _ _ _ (List.nth_error_In _ _ HMj) Hh Hq _ _ Eb) | apply universe_index_le_ul_max; cbn; lia ].
  - intros * HMk Hcon Heq E; eapply lift_exp_ge; [| exact (Hd _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hcon Heq E) ]; lia.
Qed.
